section_title: The Prayer of Our Lord Jesus Christ
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: The Prayer of Our Lord Jesus Christ.
form: Ai-ach'o ma-acháchimit ja Torro ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Aiach'o maacháchimit ja Torro ta Jesus Christus.

section_title: The Prayer of Our Lord Jesus Christ
notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: Our Father which art in Heaven, let Thy Name be praised. Let Thy dominion come. Let Thy will be done, as in Heaven, so also upon earth. Give us this day sufficient bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we also forgive them that do us evil. Let us not be tempted, and deliver us from evil. For Thine is the dominion, and the power, and the praise, for ever and ever, Amen.
form: Namoa tamau tamasea paḡa de boesum, ipá-dassa joa naan. Ipáṣaija joa chachimit o ai. Ipá-i-jorr'o oa airab maibas de boesum, masini de ta channumma. Epé-e namono piadai torro uppo ma-atsikap. Ṣo-o abó-e namo tataap o kakossi namoa, maibas channumma namo mabo tamasea parapies i namo. Hai pásabas i namo, ṣo-o barras'i namo innai rapies ai. Inau joa micho chachimit o ai, ṣo-o barr'o ai, ṣo-o adas ai, taulaulan, Amen.
standard: Namoa tamau tamasea paḡa de boesum, ipádassa joa naan. Ipáṣaija joa chachimit o ai. Ipáijorr'o oa airab maibas de boesum, masini de ta channumma. Epée namono piadai torro uppo maatsikap. Ṣoo abóe namo tataap o kakossi namoa, maibas channumma namo mabo tamasea parapies i namo. Hai pásabas i namo, ṣoo barras'i namo innai rapies ai. Inau joa micho chachimit o ai, ṣoo barr'o ai, ṣoo adas ai, taulaulan, Amen.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: The Christian Belief.
form: Autat o Christan.
standard: Autat o Christan.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: I believe in God the Father, the Almighty Creator of Heaven and earth: and in Jesus Christ, His only begotten Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the pure breath of God, the Holy Ghost, born of the betrothed virgin Mary, who suffered under the judge Pontius Pilate, was nailed to the cross, who died, was buried, and descended into the pool of fire, that is Hell; the third day He arose from the dead; ascended to Heaven, and sitteth on the right hand of His Father, the Almighty; from whence He shall return to judge the quick and the dead. I believe in the pure breath of God, the Holy Ghost; I believe in' a communion of a pure or holy Christian people, that has been of times of old, is now, and always shall remain; in the communion that is, the communion of Saints; the forgiveness of sins the resurrection of the flesh; and in life everlasting. Amen.
form: Ka na-a poetautaṭ inni Deos o Tamau, Airien o boesum, a ta kamabarr'ija tapos o ai; Ṣo-o inni ta Jesus Christus choa sjiem nattaṣar o binodda ma-acháchimit ja torro, tamasea karinab innaide Auchar o Deos o ma-áchimit, ta Spirito Santo, kabinodd'o patómammali ta Maria. Minachoté o ai de rapo ma-achachált ta Pontius Pilatus, tsiniltillan i ṣaṣakimotto, minachá, chinap o ta, ṣinoss'i chauch o chau, michoṣar a pattite, gehenna. Ka natorroa da zijsja minaṣéas a macha. Tsinnummaḡach i boesum, airoossen i kallamas o choa Tamau kamabarr'ija tapos o ai; Innaide icho ṣaṣai pacheoach, alla mierien o chachalt o cho morich-a ṣo-o macháda ai. Kana-a poetautat inni ta Auchar o Deos o ma-áchimit, ta Spirito Santo. Na-a pittau o aiḡarrórro-no cho Christan o ma-achimit, o ai pinaga ani-aicho, paga pia ṣo-o kapapoetautachṣar. Rorróno-ad'o chono ma-achimit ai. Ábono tataap o kakossi ai. Aṣéas o bo'ai. Ṣo-o morícho o ma-áchonṣar ai. Amen.
standard: Ka naa poetautaṭ inni Deos o Tamau, Airien o boesum, a ta kamabarr'ija tapos o ai; Ṣoo inni ta Jesus Christus choa sjiem nattaṣar o binodda maacháchimit ja torro, tamasea karinab innaide Auchar o Deos o maáchimit, ta Spirito Santo, kabinodd'o patómammali ta Maria. Minachoté o ai de rapo maachachált ta Pontius Pilatus, tsiniltillan i ṣaṣakimotto, minachá, chinap o ta, ṣinoss'i chauch o chau, michoṣar a pattite, gehenna. Ka natorroa da zijsja minaṣéas a macha. Tsinnummaḡach i boesum, airoossen i kallamas o choa Tamau kamabarr'ija tapos o ai; Innaide icho ṣaṣai pacheoach, alla mierien o chachalt o cho moricha ṣoo macháda ai. Ka naa poetautat inni ta Auchar o Deos o maáchimit, ta Spirito Santo. Naa pittau o aiḡarrórrono cho Christan o maachimit, o ai pinaga aniaicho, paga pia ṣoo kapapoetautachṣar. Rorróno ad'o chono maachimit ai. Ábono tataap o kakossi ai. Aṣéas o bo'ai. Ṣoo morícho o maáchonṣar ai. Amen.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: The Ten Commandments of the Lord.
form: Tschiet o Áttillono ta Jehova.
standard: Tschiet o Áttillono ta Jehova.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: preamble
notes: Introductory text before the numbered items
translation: God spake all these words: I am the Lord Thy God, who hast led thee out of the land of Egypt, the house of bondage.
form: Ta Deos ma-chó tapos o atite o miniṣar: Ka-ina paga ta Jehova oa Deosoë, tamasea piná-i-jor ijo innai ta Egipten, don o aran ai.
standard: Ta Deos machó tapos o atite o miniṣar: Ka ina paga ta Jehova oa Deosoë, tamasea pináijor ijo innai ta Egipten, don o aran ai.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_01
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thou shalt have no other Gods before me.
form: Alii papaga ijonoë' Deos a; roman katinnaam o na-amorra-dech.
standard: Alii papaga ijonoë' Deos a; roman katinnaam o naamorradech.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_02
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness, of anything above in Heaven, of anything here below on earth; or of anything in the waters under the earth; thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, and thou shalt not serve them; for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me; and showing mercy to many thousands that love me and keep my commandments.
form: Alii mamerien ijonoë a oa boa o isas a ḡinaat ja charri o tatschier; pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai lallum boesum de babó: pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai babó ta de rapó: pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai lallum to de rapó ta: alli papadachum ijonoë katinnaam o decho, ṣo-o alli allecho aran o decho, inau ka-ina ta Jehova oa Deosoë, Deos maddobor a tsjes, tamasea ṣummad'o arapies o tamauno inni sisjiem pana natorroa, ṣo-o kanaspat a tupponodon, tamasea masásso ina; ṣo-o kamabo ina o mapan manna-achpil a tschiet eis, tamasea maukat o ina, ṣo-o ummior o na-a atillo.
standard: Alii mamerien ijonoë a oa boa o isas a ḡinaat ja charri o tatschier; pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai lallum boesum de babó: pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai babó ta de rapó: pagaga chaddai innai charri o ai lallum to de rapó ta: alli papadachum ijonoë katinnaam o decho, ṣoo alli allecho aran o decho, inau ka ina ta Jehova oa Deosoë, Deos maddobor a tsjes, tamasea ṣummad'o arapies o tamauno inni sisjiem pana natorroa, ṣoo kanaspat a tupponodon, tamasea masásso ina; ṣoo kamabo ina o mapan mannaachpil a tschiet eis, tamasea maukat o ina, ṣoo ummior o naa atillo.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_03
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thou shalt not idly pronounce or use the name of the Lord thy God, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh His name in vain.
form: Alli mamarach o baak o naan o Jehova oa Deos-ech, inau ta Jehova alli mamabono chono ai, kamarach o baak o choa naan.
standard: Alli mamarach o baak o naan o Jehova oa Deosech, inau ta Jehova alli mamabono chono ai, kamarach o baak o choa naan.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_04
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it pure or holy. Six days shalt thou labour and finish all thy work; but the seventh day is the Sabbath, that is, the resting time of the Lord thy God; on that day thou shalt not do any work, neither thyself nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thy ox, nor thy stranger that dwelleth in thy land; for in six days the Lord finished creating Heaven and earth, the sea, and all that therein is, and He rested the seventh day, therefore the Lord commands to celebrate the Sabbath day, and to keep it holy.
form: Tuppána o zijsj'o Sabbath-ai, all'ijo pachímit o aicho. Nataap a rummies tatummaap ijonoë, ṣo-o a-ummoob o tapos oa tataap; ṣo-o naitoa zijsja paga Sabbath, michoṣar a pattite, aissassen o Jehova oa Deos-ech: paga tatummaap ijo de ailo charri o ai, pa ijo, pa oa sjiem badda, pa oa sjiem mammali, pa oa aran o badda, ja mammali pa oa loan o tummaap, pa oa azjiesech de oa ta; inau lallum nataap a zijsja ta Jehova inummoob o boesum, o ta, a abás, ṣo-o tapos o ai de lallum ailoe, ṣo-o kanaitoa zijsja pissassen icho, inau decho ta Jehova pinárab o zijsj'o Sabbath ai, ṣo-o pinachímit o micho.
standard: Tuppána o zijsj'o Sabbath ai, all'ijo pachímit o aicho. Nataap a rummies tatummaap ijonoë, ṣoo aummoob o tapos oa tataap; ṣoo naitoa zijsja paga Sabbath, michoṣar a pattite, aissassen o Jehova oa Deosech: paga tatummaap ijo de ailo charri o ai, pa ijo, pa oa sjiem badda, pa oa sjiem mammali, pa oa aran o badda, ja mammali pa oa loan o tummaap, pa oa azjiesech de oa ta; inau lallum nataap a zijsja ta Jehova inummoob o boesum, o ta, a abás, ṣoo tapos o ai de lallum ailoe, ṣoo kanaitoa zijsja pissassen icho, inau decho ta Jehova pinárab o zijsj'o Sabbath ai, ṣoo pinachímit o micho.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_05
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Be modest or respectful to thy father and mother, that thy days be prolonged in the land, that the Lord thy God giveth thee.
form: A-arichá oa tamau ṣo-o oa tanai, alla moab o zijsja de ta-ech, ta Jehova oa Deos pe'o ijo.
standard: Aarichá oa tamau ṣoo oa tanai, alla moab o zijsja de taech, ta Jehova oa Deos pe'o ijo.

label: item_06
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thou shalt not kill.

standard: Alli papach'o machá ijonoë.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord

notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted

form: Alli chachummod ijonoë.
standard: Alli chachummod ijonoë.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_08
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted

standard: Alli mamchap ijonoë.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_09

standard: Alli papattite ijonoë o tattassal maattosik kasjabaan oa maacháddik o cho.

section_title: The Ten Commandments of the Lord
label: item_10
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, and thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his man-servant, nor his maid-servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that belongs to thy neighbour.
form: Alli mamaksas o don oa maacháddik o cho, alli mamaksas o roos oa ma-acháddik o cho, ja cho aran o badda, ja mammali, ja choa loan o tummaap, ja chao loan o maraag, ja charri o ai kamaunis a oa ma-acháddik o chonoë.
standard: Alli mamaksas o don oa maacháddik o cho, alli mamaksas o roos oa maacháddik o cho, ja cho aran o badda, ja mammali, ja choa loan o tummaap, ja chao loan o maraag, ja charri o ai kamaunis a oa maacháddik o chonoë.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: The Morning Prayer.
form: Ai-ach'o Patsjisimma.
standard: Aiach'o Patsjisimma.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: Merciful Father! we praise Thee, that Thou hast so faithfully watched over us during the past night, and we pray Thee that Thou mayest strengthen us by Thy pure breath, the Holy Ghost; that He may henceforth lead us, so that in every work of righteousness and purity we may end this day, as also all the other days of our life; and that to whatsoever we apply ourselves we may always endeavour openly to declare Thy praise, since we can expect from Thy bounteous hand alone the assistance required in all our labours. And in order we may obtain this mercy from Thee, forgive us, according to the testimony of Thy word, our transgressions, only and alone for the sufferings of our Lord and Mediator, who shed His blood for us; and because we repent of our sins. Enlighten also our souls, so that after abandoning all the works of darkness, we may as the children of light enter upon a new life, and walk in the righteous paths of God. Give also Thy assistance in the work of proclaiming Thy word, and making it known in all parts of the world. Disperse all the works of Satan. Strengthen all teachers of Thy Word, and all the chiefs of Thy people. Comfort all persons who are persecuted and who suffer affliction; for the sake of Thy beloved Son, who hast testified unto us that Thou wilt give us all things we pray for in His Name, and therefore Thou hast taught us thus to pray: - Our Father, etc.
form: Ma-abó a Tamau madas ijo namo, all'ijo rínummi i torroani bi-ini masini o gagil, ṣo-o meách'ijo, alla merab ijo pábarr'i torro o ta joa Auchar o ma-áchimit-ech, alla pana rummi-es pa-i-jor i namo ja ichoṣar, alla namo inni tapos o tataap o babissé a chímit ummoob o zijsj'o mini, maibas channumm'o tapos zijsj'o torroa morich: ṣo-o tummalpon onúmm'ija namo, alla torro tallochon maddobor o pattite o tapos assaban oa adas; masiniṣar alla torro tummassín o a-olli-eul o torroa tapos o tataap innai joa ma-adaldál a rima ma-akamunchiṣar. Ṣo-o alla namo marach o bóno mini innai ijo, erábbana mabó i namo, kamaibas o al'o joa ranied, o tapos torroa kakossi, inau machoté o ma-áchimit, ṣo-o ṣaṣa-ód o taḡḡ'o torroa ma-acháchimit a maazínado ta Jesus Christus; inau machia ja torroa tsjes aicho-íes. Ipárara channumm'o torroa tsjes, alla namo, kaitis o tapos o tataap o odum, maibas o sisjiem o rará tummalpon o bao a morich, alla mababat inni tapos o babissé o ta Deos. Ipachípp'oa a-olli-eul channumma, ino akaukáuan ṣo-o ipab'oa ranied de tapos o ta. Ipáurtatach'o tapos o tataap o ta Ṣaitan. Ipabarrá o tapos ma-átil o joa ranied, ṣo-o ta ma-acháchimit o joa chosar. Talattalá o tapos liollioón a cho, ṣo-o tsiannanni a tsjes, inau oa aukáttan a sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, tamasea minaunis o al'i namo, alla tapos o ai torro meách'inni choa naan, gagil oa pape'i namo, ṣo-o inau micho pináttillo torro meach'o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.
standard: Maabó a Tamau madas ijo namo, all'ijo rínummi i torroani biini masini o gagil, ṣoo meách'ijo, alla merab ijo pábarr'i torro o ta joa Auchar o maáchimitech, alla pana rummies paijor i namo ja ichoṣar, alla namo inni tapos o tataap o babissé a chímit ummoob o zijsj'o mini, maibas channumm'o tapos zijsj'o torroa morich: ṣoo tummalpon onúmm'ija namo, alla torro tallochon maddobor o pattite o tapos assaban oa adas; masiniṣar alla torro tummassín o aollieul o torroa tapos o tataap innai joa maadaldál a rima maakamunchiṣar. Ṣoo alla namo marach o bóno mini innai ijo, erábbana mabó i namo, kamaibas o al'o joa ranied, o tapos torroa kakossi, inau machoté o maáchimit, ṣoo ṣaṣaód o taḡḡ'o torroa maacháchimit a maazínado ta Jesus Christus; inau machia ja torroa tsjes aichoíes. Ipárara channumm'o torroa tsjes, alla namo, kaitis o tapos o tataap o odum, maibas o sisjiem o rará tummalpon o bao a morich, alla mababat inni tapos o babissé o ta Deos. Ipachípp'oa aollieul channumma, ino akaukáuan ṣoo ipab'oa ranied de tapos o ta. Ipáurtatach'o tapos o tataap o ta Ṣaitan. Ipabarrá o tapos maátil o joa ranied, ṣoo ta maacháchimit o joa chosar. Talattalá o tapos liollioón a cho, ṣoo tsiannanni a tsjes, inau oa aukáttan a sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, tamasea minaunis o al'i namo, alla tapos o ai torro meách'inni choa naan, gagil oa pape'i namo, ṣoo inau micho pináttillo torro meach'o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: The Evening Prayer.
form: Ai-ach'o Marpesa.
standard: Aiach'o Marpesa.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: Merciful God! Eternal Light, that shinest in the darkness, who dispellest the darkness of wicked works and enlightenest the benighted mind, inasmuch as Thou dost appoint the night for rest, even as the day for labour; we pray Thee that our bodies may rest in quiet and peace, so that they may be fit to perform the work they have to do. Moderate our sleep, so that it may not be excessive, and that our bodies and minds may remain pure; nay, may our sleep give cause to praise Thy Name. Enlighten also the eyes of our understanding, so that we may not remain sleeping unto death, but let us rather live in constant hope of being delivered from the evil afflictions of this world. Protect us also from all the temptations of Satan; lead all as Thy children by Thy pure breath (the Holy Ghost), and although we have not finished this day without having committed great and wicked sins against Thy will; we pray Thee, that Thy mercy may cover all our trespasses, even as Thou dost cover all things upon this earth with the darkness of night, so that we may not be cast forth from Thy countenance. Give also rest and consolation to all sick persons, to all who are afflicted, to all souls harassed by Satan; for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath taught us thus to pray: - Our Father, etc.
form: Deos o ma-ábo a tsjes rará o maáchonṣar o ai tumṣar i odum, tamasea paube o bi-ini o tataap o arapies, ṣo-o rapalna tsjes; inau kaitan ijo páṣai o bi-ini, alla pissassen, maibas o zijsja, alla tummaap; meach'ijo namo ipaissassen'o torroa bog kakaitsítsi a ma-a-árra, alla mamatsikap asag-á moddon o tataap, o ai maspot a ummoob aichoies. Ipaka-qua'o torroa ṣaṣárra, depa matsiballách ja micho, alla máchonṣar ma-áchimit o torroa bog a tsjes-oë; hena channumma alla padás ja oa naan torroa ṣaṣárra. Íparar'o machá o torroa ṣaan, depa máchonṣar ṣummarra ja namo inni machá: kasjabaan ipatassina torro tallochon ino barrasan ja torro innai zichil o rapies de babo ta mini. Aladikk'i namo channumma innai tapos o lalál'o ta Ṣaitan: maibas oa sisjiem a-i-jorr'i namo o ta joa ma-áchimit o Auchar-ech. Ṣo-o pagatomma torro inummoob o zijsj'o mini, alli marotul o kakossi kossi; tataap o kakossi mato a rapies kasjabaan oa airab; meách'ijo namo, erábbana tummakkoop torroa kakossi o joa bó, maibas ijo tummakkoop o tapos ai babó ta mini o odum o bi-ini, depa inau decho kartattisan ja namo innai joa morra-dech. Ipáissassena channumma ṣo-o talattalá o tapos cho ma-ádig, ma-ázichil, ṣo-o lalan a a tsjes innai ta Ṣaitan, inau maacháchimit ja torro ta Jesus Christus, tamasea pináttil i namo meách'o o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.
standard: Deos o maábo a tsjes rará o maáchonṣar o ai tumṣar i odum, tamasea paube o biini o tataap o arapies, ṣoo rapalna tsjes; inau kaitan ijo páṣai o biini, alla pissassen, maibas o zijsja, alla tummaap; meach'ijo namo ipaissassen'o torroa bog kakaitsítsi a maaárra, alla mamatsikap asagá moddon o tataap, o ai maspot a ummoob aichoies. Ipakaqua'o torroa ṣaṣárra, depa matsiballách ja micho, alla máchonṣar maáchimit o torroa bog a tsjesoë; hena channumma alla padás ja oa naan torroa ṣaṣárra. Íparar'o machá o torroa ṣaan, depa máchonṣar ṣummarra ja namo inni machá: kasjabaan ipatassina torro tallochon ino barrasan ja torro innai zichil o rapies de babo ta mini. Aladikk'i namo channumma innai tapos o lalál'o ta Ṣaitan: maibas oa sisjiem aijorr'i namo o ta joa maáchimit o Aucharech. Ṣoo pagatomma torro inummoob o zijsj'o mini, alli marotul o kakossi kossi; tataap o kakossi mato a rapies kasjabaan oa airab; meách'ijo namo, erábbana tummakkoop torroa kakossi o joa bó, maibas ijo tummakkoop o tapos ai babó ta mini o odum o biini, depa inau decho kartattisan ja namo innai joa morradech. Ipáissassena channumma ṣoo talattalá o tapos cho maádig, maázichil, ṣoo lalan a a tsjes innai ta Ṣaitan, inau maacháchimit ja torro ta Jesus Christus, tamasea pináttil i namo meách'o o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Prayer Before Meals.
form: Ai-ach'o tinnaam Man.
standard: Aiach'o tinnaam Man.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: All eyes wait upon Thee, and thou givest them food in due season. Thou openest Thy hand, and satisfieth every thing that liveth, according to Thy almighty will. Almighty Ruler, Almighty God! who hast created all things, and who by Thy divine power constantly upholdest all things; Thou who hast fed Thy people Israel in the wilderness, graciously extend now Thy bounty to Thy poor servants, and bless these gifts unto us; the gifts which we receive from Thy bountiful hand; so that we may moderately, and in singleness of heart, partake of them, thus acknowledging that Thou art our Father, and that Thou art the source from whence all good cometh. Grant that we may always, and above all other things, seek the Bread of the soul, Thy Word, so that our souls may be fed unto Life everlasting, which Thou hast promised to give us, only for the sake of the great suffering of Thy beloved Son Jesus Christ. Amen.
form: Machá o tapos o ai tummassín ijo: ṣo-o ijo pe'i decho cho'inochan ka choa rasoom. Ijo kumrár oa rima, ṣo-o padabbi o tapos, o ai morích, kamaibas o aukat oa airab. Ma-acháchimit ta Deos kamabarr'ija tapos o ai, tamasea minerienṣar o tapos ai, ṣo-o tumka taulaulan lan oa barr'o Deossar, ijo tamasea pinaán o chono Israel inni maaimoch a bonna, erábbana tummó joa al-ál i babó torro joa aran o ma-aṣábba, ṣo-o paátsikap i namo áṣosono mini, torro marach innai joa ma-adaldál a rió, alla torro kamaibas o mario oa airab tsimimis o qua a chímit aicho-ies, ṣo-o innai micho madarram alla paga ijo namoa Tamau, ṣo-o chuppód o gagil o tapos rió. Epé-e channumma alla tallochon ṣo-o tinnaam o tapos ai torro summad'o úppono tsjessar, oa ranied innínumma channan ja torroa tsjes pana morích o ma-áchonṣar, o ai pinab'o pape'i namo ijonoë, inau machoté o maáchimit oa aukattan a sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, Amen.
standard: Machá o tapos o ai tummassín ijo: ṣoo ijo pe'i decho cho'inochan ka choa rasoom. Ijo kumrár oa rima, ṣoo padabbi o tapos, o ai morích, kamaibas o aukat oa airab. Maacháchimit ta Deos kamabarr'ija tapos o ai, tamasea minerienṣar o tapos ai, ṣoo tumka taulaulan lan oa barr'o Deossar, ijo tamasea pinaán o chono Israel inni maaimoch a bonna, erábbana tummó joa alál i babó torro joa aran o maaṣábba, ṣoo paátsikap i namo áṣosono mini, torro marach innai joa maadaldál a rió, alla torro kamaibas o mario oa airab tsimimis o qua a chímit aichoies, ṣoo innai micho madarram alla paga ijo namoa Tamau, ṣoo chuppód o gagil o tapos rió. Epée channumma alla tallochon ṣoo tinnaam o tapos ai torro summad'o úppono tsjessar, oa ranied innínumma channan ja torroa tsjes pana morích o maáchonṣar, o ai pinab'o pape'i namo ijonoë, inau machoté o maáchimit oa aukattan a sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, Amen.

section_title: Prayer To Be Used After Meals
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Prayer To Be Used After Meals.
form: Ai-ach'o a-i-jor a Man.
standard: Aiach'o aijor a Man.

section_title: Prayer To Be Used After Meals
notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: After thou hast partaken of food, and art satisfied, thou shalt praise the Lord Thy God for the fertile land that He hath given thee. Take heed that ye do not forget the Lord thy God, and that ye neglect not to keep His commandments and His statutes, as well as the institutions of His Word, which I have (given) commanded you this day. Almighty Ruler, God our Heavenly Father, we praise Thee for all Thy benefits, which we are continually receiving from Thy bountiful hand; that it is Thy divine will we should be sustained by Thee in this transitory life; and that Thou dost give us all that we require; above all things, that Thou hast begotten us unto the hope of a better life, which Thou hast made known unto us through the pure word of Thy Gospel. Merciful God and Father! we pray Thee, that Thou wilt not suffer our souls to cleave unto the perishable possessions of this world; let us on the contrary continually look up to heaven, whence we expect our Saviour Jesus Christ, till He shall appear in the clouds to deliver us. Amen.
form: Ka ochal mamán a mamaddabí ijonoë, mamadas ijo i ta Jehova oa Deos-ech, inau marió a ta, o ai ochal icho pape'imonoë. E-íllá na joa micho boa, depa poach ijo i ta Jehova, oa Deosṣar, kailau ijo pa ummior o choa átillo, a choa bissebissé, a ṣaṣirau choa ranied, o ai na-a páttillo imoa piadái. Ma-acháchimit ta Deos Tamau de boesum, madás, ijo namo inau tapos joa tataap o rio, torro tallochon marach innai joa ma-adaldál a rima, alla paga oa airab o Deosṣar porích torro boa inni morích o maauribál o mini, ṣo-o pe'i torro tapos o ai maṣabb'ija namo: kamaunionis, all'ijo pinodd'o tattaul'i namo ka tattassín o máso mario a morích, o ai pinab'i namo ijonoë inni oa maáchimit o ranied o Evangelium. Deos o Tamau ma-ábo a tsjes, meach'ijo namo, depa kummono ijo alla mamáchonṣar torroa tsjes insini mikkap o ma-auribál a ballach de ta mini: kasjabaán ipádaukoa torro tallochon pana boesum, all'innaide tummassín torroa maababárras ta Jesus Christus, áte tatummoach icho lallum rabbo pana torroa babarrás, Amen.
standard: Ka ochal mamán a mamaddabí ijonoë, mamadas ijo i ta Jehova oa Deosech, inau marió a ta, o ai ochal icho pape'imonoë. Eíllá na joa micho boa, depa poach ijo i ta Jehova, oa Deosṣar, kailau ijo pa ummior o choa átillo, a choa bissebissé, a ṣaṣirau choa ranied, o ai naa páttillo imoa piadái. Maacháchimit ta Deos Tamau de boesum, madás, ijo namo inau tapos joa tataap o rio, torro tallochon marach innai joa maadaldál a rima, alla paga oa airab o Deosṣar porích torro boa inni morích o maauribál o mini, ṣoo pe'i torro tapos o ai maṣabb'ija namo: kamaunionis, all'ijo pinodd'o tattaul'i namo ka tattassín o máso mario a morích, o ai pinab'i namo ijonoë inni oa maáchimit o ranied o Evangelium. Deos o Tamau maábo a tsjes, meach'ijo namo, depa kummono ijo alla mamáchonṣar torroa tsjes insini mikkap o maauribál a ballach de ta mini: kasjabaán ipádaukoa torro tallochon pana boesum, all'innaide tummassín torroa maababárras ta Jesus Christus, áte tatummoach icho lallum rabbo pana torroa babarrás, Amen.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Prayer Before Religious Instruction.
form: Ai-acha katinnaam Atil.
standard: Aiacha katinnaam Atil.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: Come, let us thus pray to God:- O God our heavenly Father! Thy Name is beginning to shed its light upon us, and we are now gathered together to listen to Thy Word, and to be instructed therein: Open our deaf ears, and illumine our dark understandings, in order that we may fully comprehend, understand, and ponder on Thy doctrine, for the sake of Jesus Christ Thy beloved Son. Amen.
form: Assánman-a torro meach'o Deos-ṣar masini:- Deos o Tamau de boesum, kapesasa tummoach i namo joa naan: ṣo-o marórro ja namo, alla maṣini ṣo-o pattil o joa ranied. Tsikakk'i torroa chorrien a charrina, ṣo-o ipátillaḡḡ'o torroa ma-audum a tsjes, alla marach ja namo, maba, ṣo-o tump'o ḡagíl oa atil inau ta Jesus Christus oa sjiem badd'aukattan, Amen,
standard: Assánmana torro meach'o Deosṣar masini:- Deos o Tamau de boesum, kapesasa tummoach i namo joa naan: ṣoo marórro ja namo, alla maṣini ṣoo pattil o joa ranied. Tsikakk'i torroa chorrien a charrina, ṣoo ipátillaḡḡ'o torroa maaudum a tsjes, alla marach ja namo, maba, ṣoo tump'o ḡagíl oa atil inau ta Jesus Christus oa sjiem badd'aukattan, Amen,

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Prayer After Religious Instruction.
form: Ai-acha a-i-jor a Atil.
standard: Aiacha aijor a Atil.

notes: Printed primary section joined across page boundaries
translation: Come, let us praise and laud our God, now that we have been instructed in His Word. O God, Almighty Father! we have heard that Thou art our Father, that Thou createst, feedest, and sustainest all men. We praise Thy Name, because Thou hast pity upon us, and didst come to call us, to be Thine own peculiar people and children of God. Grant that we may rejoice, and ponder in our hearts on this Thy great mercy, so that we may put off the old man, and as new men follow in the steps of Thy Son Jesus Christ, who has taught us thus to pray: - Our Father, etc.
form: Kapoṣisi pattil o pia annum mánnumma torroa mamadás i ta Deos masini. Deoso Tamau kamabarr'ija tapos o ai, kaminaṣini ja namo, alla paga ijonoë namoa Tamau, all'ijo merienṣar, paan ṣo-o poríchṣar o tapos o cho. Madás namoa joa naan, inau mabo ijonoe a torro boa, ṣo-o mai malod namono, alla paga oa maunis a cho, ṣo-o sisjiem o Deos. Epé-e maukat namo, ṣo-o tump'i tsjes matoto oa bóno miniṣar, alla namo tummis o raras a cho, ṣo-o maibas o bao a cho tsimichier o morich oa sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, tamasea pináttil i namo meach'o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.
standard: Kapoṣisi pattil o pia annum mánnumma torroa mamadás i ta Deos masini. Deoso Tamau kamabarr'ija tapos o ai, kaminaṣini ja namo, alla paga ijonoë namoa Tamau, all'ijo merienṣar, paan ṣoo poríchṣar o tapos o cho. Madás namoa joa naan, inau mabo ijonoe a torro boa, ṣoo mai malod namono, alla paga oa maunis a cho, ṣoo sisjiem o Deos. Epée maukat namo, ṣoo tump'i tsjes matoto oa bóno miniṣar, alla namo tummis o raras a cho, ṣoo maibas o bao a cho tsimichier o morich oa sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus, tamasea pináttil i namo meach'o masini:-Namoa Tamau, etc.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger.
form: Karri-atite tuppach o sjam Ternern, ṣo-o ta Holland'-azjies.
standard: Karriatite tuppach o sjam Ternern, ṣoo ta Holland' azjies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_01_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, stranger, from whence do you come?
form: Azjies au innainumm'ijo kamai insini?
standard: Azjies au innainumm'ijo kamai insini?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_01_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I come from a great distance, from the extreme part of the west.
form: Kaminai ja ina innai maro, innai ṣies o tsipan-ech.
standard: Kaminai ja ina innai maro, innai ṣies o tsipanech.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_02_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You don't say so! Are you not tired of having walked such a long distance?
form: Tanaas! ja alli orachan o mababat talcho a maro a tarran?
standard: Tanaas! ja alli orachan o mababat talcho a maro a tarran?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_02_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I have not walked; I was sitting in a large ship, that passed over the sea like a bird.
form: Paga minababat ina; ka minero-os ja ina de don o mato pasji tarran o abas, maibas o mampa.
standard: Paga minababat ina; ka mineroos ja ina de don o mato pasji tarran o abas, maibas o mampa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_03_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Is it possible? Were you long on the way?
form: Tanaas! ja milip de tarran ijonoë?
standard: Tanaas! ja milip de tarran ijonoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_03_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, even more than half a year.
form: Hena; maso milip a ḡeroan a baas.
standard: Hena; maso milip a ḡeroan a baas.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_04_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What do you come here for?
form: Mai merien onumm'insini?
standard: Mai merien onumm'insini?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_04_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I came to visit the Favorlangers.
form: Na-a mai tumboel Ternern.
standard: Naa mai tumboel Ternern.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_05_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Have you come only to visit us?
form: Ja oa mai tumboel baakṣar?
standard: Ja oa mai tumboel baakṣar?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_05_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: No, not only to visit you.
form: Maini: paḡaḡa baakṣar?
standard: Maini: paḡaḡa baakṣar?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_06_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, what do you come to do here?
form: Mai maspot onumma?
standard: Mai maspot onumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_06_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I desire to teach the Favorlangers the way to heaven.
form: Ka na-a maddobor pattil i Ternern o tarran i boesum ai-oë.
standard: Ka naa maddobor pattil i Ternern o tarran i boesum aioë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_07_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, how? Where is the road that leads to heaven? Does there exist such a long ladder that it will reach to heaven?
form: Oedan, pasji dem'ausoán tarran pana boesum ai; ja paga talcho a ma-atsiló a kittas pana boesum?
standard: Oedan, pasji dem'ausoán tarran pana boesum ai; ja paga talcho a maatsiló a kittas pana boesum?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_07_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You are very foolish; do you not know that God leads the righteous souls to heaven?
form: Chubboen ijo, ja mautsiri alla ta Deos maracho ma-abisséa tsjes o ai i boesum-ech?
standard: Chubboen ijo, ja mautsiri alla ta Deos maracho maabisséa tsjes o ai i boesumech?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_08_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I thought that haibos took away our souls.
form: Na'esurro, alla ta haibos marach o torroa tsjes-oë.
standard: Na'esurro, alla ta haibos marach o torroa tsjesoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_08_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Who is haibos, a man or a ghost?
form: Numm'ija haibos ja babosa ja richá?
standard: Numm'ija haibos ja babosa ja richá?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_09_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I don't know.
form: Nachá.
standard: Nachá.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_09_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well then, whom do you call haibos?
form: Oedan, pattonan onumm'ijo ta haibos.
standard: Oedan, pattonan onumm'ijo ta haibos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_10_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I don't know. Whom do you call God?
form: Nachánumma: tomm'ijo pattonan ta Deos?
standard: Nachánumma: tomm'ijo pattonan ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_10_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: The Creator of heaven, of the earth and of the sea: Him I call God.
form: Ná-a pattonan o Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, ta Deos.
standard: Náa pattonan o Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, ta Deos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_11_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You talk nonsense! Is there a Creator of heaven and earth?
form: Ijo mauranies: ja pagá Airien o boesum a ta?
standard: Ijo mauranies: ja pagá Airien o boesum a ta?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_11_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Certainly, there is.
form: Gagil pagá.
standard: Gagil pagá.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_12_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What is his name?
form: Naan onumm'icho?
standard: Naan onumm'icho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_12_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: His own name is Jehovah; in foreign languages, it is Deos.
form: Choa maunis naan pagá ta Jehova, inni atite o azjies, ta Deos.
standard: Choa maunis naan pagá ta Jehova, inni atite o azjies, ta Deos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_13_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What does Jehovah signify?
form: Numma micho a pattite, Jehova?
standard: Numma micho a pattite, Jehova?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_13_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Jehovah signifies a being or person who has always been, is, and always will remain.
form: Jehova, micho a pattite, nattada ḡa ja boa tamasea pinaga, paga, ṣo-o machonṣar taulaulan.
standard: Jehova, micho a pattite, nattada ḡa ja boa tamasea pinaga, paga, ṣoo machonṣar taulaulan.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_14_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: We do not know anything about God. Can you indeed prove that there is a God?
form: Mautsirì i ta Deos ja namo; ja mab'o pait'ijonoë alla paga ta Deos?
standard: Mautsirì i ta Deos ja namo; ja mab'o pait'ijonoë alla paga ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_14_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, I can.
form: Hena: maba.
standard: Hena: maba.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_15_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: How do you prove that?
form: Innainumm'ijo pait'o ail-oë?
standard: Innainumm'ijo pait'o ailoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_15_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I prove that from the great wisdom and power of God.
form: Na-a pait'o micho innai aba ṣo-o barr'o Deos talcho a mato.
standard: Naa pait'o micho innai aba ṣoo barr'o Deos talcho a mato.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_16_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: In what things does God prove His manifold power and wisdom?
form: Dema ta Deos pait'o choa barro, ṣo-o aba matoto?
standard: Dema ta Deos pait'o choa barro, ṣoo aba matoto?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_16_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: In His own works.
form: Inni choa maunis o tataap.
standard: Inni choa maunis o tataap.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_17_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What works?
form: Tataap onumma?
standard: Tataap onumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_17_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Very mighty and glorious works.
form: Tataap mauchus a ma-ábarra, ma-atásso.
standard: Tataap mauchus a maábarra, maatásso.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_18_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What may these works be?
form: Ipab'o tataap o mini?
standard: Ipab'o tataap o mini?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_18_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Heaven, the earth, the sea, sun, moon, large and small stars, the clouds, lightning, thunder, earthquakes.
form: Boesum, tapos o ta, abas, zijsja, idas, babóan, aisennas, rabbo, lalka, bioa, sasio.
standard: Boesum, tapos o ta, abas, zijsja, idas, babóan, aisennas, rabbo, lalka, bioa, sasio.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_19_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Are these all God's own works?
form: Ja mini tapos ai paga maunis a tataap o Deos?
standard: Ja mini tapos ai paga maunis a tataap o Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_19_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They are.
form: Paḡána.
standard: Paḡána.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_20_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: How do you prove that?
form: Moed'ijo pait'o micho?
standard: Moed'ijo pait'o micho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_20_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I prove it in this way: either heaven, earth, and the sea have always existed, or some one has made them.
form: Na-a paita masini; ja pinaga taulaulan boesum, a ta, ṣo-o abas, ja inerien, innai de romanech.
standard: Naa paita masini; ja pinaga taulaulan boesum, a ta, ṣoo abas, ja inerien, innai de romanech.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_21_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Perhaps heaven has not been made by some one, but has always existed of itself.
form: Matalam alli inerien innai de roman-ech, kamaunis pinaga boesum taulaulan?
standard: Matalam alli inerien innai de romanech, kamaunis pinaga boesum taulaulan?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_21_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You err. That the heaven has been made by another, is proved by its glory.
form: Ijo poelakies. All'inerien ja boesum innaide roman, na-a pait'innai cho'a-lá.
standard: Ijo poelakies. All'inerien ja boesum innaide roman, naa pait'innai cho'alá.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_22_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What is the glory of heaven?
form: Numm'ija a-lá o boesum?
standard: Numm'ija alá o boesum?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_22_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: That it is round like a globe, quite transparent, and that in its whole circumference there are many lights.
form: Alla moḡariniḡini, machallo-chállo o auchos aicho-ech ṣo-o mapan rará inni choa baan o lallum.
standard: Alla moḡariniḡini, machallochállo o auchos aichoech ṣoo mapan rará inni choa baan o lallum.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_23_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Has heaven been made and adorned by another being?
form: Ja inaal-lá innai de roman boesum aioë?
standard: Ja inaallá innai de roman boesum aioë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_23_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Has heaven itself adorned its structure?
form: Ja boesum maunis minall'o cho'achieb?
standard: Ja boesum maunis minall'o cho'achieb?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_24_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Perhaps!
form: Matalam!
standard: Matalam!

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_24_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: By no means!
form: Pagaga chaddai!
standard: Pagaga chaddai!

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_25_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why?
form: Inaunumma?
standard: Inaunumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_25_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: There is neither life, nor understanding, nor knowledge in its whole structure. Hence it follows, that if heaven has been adorned by some one else, it has also been made by some one else. He who has adorned heaven, has also created heaven.
form: Pa moríchṣar, pa ṣaan ja aba ini choa tapos achieb: innainumma ummior, sja inaal-lá innai de roman boesum ai, all-ineriensar channumma innai de roman-ech: tamasea pinaal-lá o boesum kamaunis minerien o boesum channumma.
standard: Pa moríchṣar, pa ṣaan ja aba ini choa tapos achieb: innainumma ummior, sja inaallá innai de roman boesum ai, allineriensar channumma innai de romanech: tamasea pinaallá o boesum kamaunis minerien o boesum channumma.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_26_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You are in the right. What other evidence have you that heaven has been created by some one?
form: Ka ummior ina. Innainumm'ijo paita taulan all'inerienṣar innai de roman boesum-ech?
standard: Ka ummior ina. Innainumm'ijo paita taulan all'inerienṣar innai de roman boesumech?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_26_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Because heaven, the sun, moon and all its lights, are subservient to the dominion of a being who makes them subservient to Him, and who commands them to serve man, the earth, the herbs, and the fruits of the field.
form: Inau boesum, zijsja, idas, ṣo-o tapos choa rará ummior o chachimit o roman-ech, tamasea pauloan aicho-ies, ṣo-o pattillo aran o cho, o ta, o baziep, o inochan.
standard: Inau boesum, zijsja, idas, ṣoo tapos choa rará ummior o chachimit o romanech, tamasea pauloan aichoies, ṣoo pattillo aran o cho, o ta, o baziep, o inochan.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_27_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Indeed! do heaven, sun, and moon, serve man, the earth, herbs, and fruits of the field?
form: Mai numma, ja boesum, zijsja, idas, aran o cho, o ta, o baziep, o inochan?
standard: Mai numma, ja boesum, zijsja, idas, aran o cho, o ta, o baziep, o inochan?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_27_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They indeed serve them.
form: Ka-aran gagilna.
standard: Kaaran gagilna.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_28_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Prove this.
form: Ipait'o ailo.
standard: Ipait'o ailo.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_28_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Heaven moves continually from east to west, and hastens to return again to the east. The sun and the moon in heaven never fail to rise and to set. The sun rises in order to illuminate the earth, to warm it, and to bring rain over the fruits of the field, the herbs, and the trees; so that they may bud, grow, and bring forth fruit.
form: Boesum tallochon magarieb innai baijan pana tsipan, ṣo-o madaap pacheoach pana bajan. Zijsja-da idas inni boesum alli poelakies o tummoach a meodup. Katummoach zijsja-da alla parar'o tapos o ta, alla pattadach ṣo-o pautas o inochan, o baziep, o baron, alla chummo-o, ṣummoos, ṣo-o poa.
standard: Boesum tallochon magarieb innai baijan pana tsipan, ṣoo madaap pacheoach pana bajan. Zijsjada idas inni boesum alli poelakies o tummoach a meodup. Katummoach zijsjada alla parar'o tapos o ta, alla pattadach ṣoo pautas o inochan, o baziep, o baron, alla chummoo, ṣummoos, ṣoo poa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_29_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What service does the moon render to man, to the fruits of the field, and to the herbs?
form: Moeda idas aran o cho, o inochan, o baziep?
standard: Moeda idas aran o cho, o inochan, o baziep?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_29_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: The moon rises and takes the place of the sun, in order to dispel the darkness of night; and through means of her moisture, she tempers the heat of the sun, so that the fruits of the field and the herbs may not wither.
form: Katumoach idas, ṣo-o rummodsi o zijsja-da, alla odum o bi-ini, ṣo-o pakaqua o choa tach tadach o zijsja, pa machá inochan ja baziep.
standard: Katumoach idas, ṣoo rummodsi o zijsjada, alla odum o biini, ṣoo pakaqua o choa tach tadach o zijsja, pa machá inochan ja baziep.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_30_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: The power must indeed be great that can command such immense bodies, and make them subservient to Him, so that they are constantly serving the earth here below, the herbs, and the fruits of the field, destined for the food of man.
form: Gagil mato a chachimit pauloan ṣo-o pattillono talcho a mato achieb, all'aicho tallochon aran o ta mini rapo, o baziep, o inochan o cho.
standard: Gagil mato a chachimit pauloan ṣoo pattillono talcho a mato achieb, all'aicho tallochon aran o ta mini rapo, o baziep, o inochan o cho.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_30_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: So it is: and hence it follows, as I wished to prove, that heaven and earth, the sun and moon, have been created by some Being, so that they may be nothing else but the servants of His power, and obey His command.
form: Gagilna: ṣo-o innai decho ummior maibas merab o paita ina, alla boesum, zijsja, idas inerienṣar innai de roman-ech, inau aicho maibas o aran ummior o chachimit ṣo-o atillo.
standard: Gagilna: ṣoo innai decho ummior maibas merab o paita ina, alla boesum, zijsja, idas inerienṣar innai de romanech, inau aicho maibas o aran ummior o chachimit ṣoo atillo.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_31_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I also agree to this. He who has dominion over heaven and all its lights, and causes them to serve Him, is surely the Creator of heaven, as you now have proved.
form: Na-a ummior channumma, tamasea pauloan ṣo-o chummimit o boesum, o tapos choa rará, gagil pagá airien o boesum, maibas o pia pinait'ija.
standard: Naa ummior channumma, tamasea pauloan ṣoo chummimit o boesum, o tapos choa rará, gagil pagá airien o boesum, maibas o pia pinait'ija.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_31_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Know, too, that the Creator of heaven is indeed powerful, bountiful, and kind; He constantly remembers man, causes the sun to rise, and also gives rain, and has pity upon us.
form: Abá channumma, all'airien o boesum gagil mabarra, ma-al-ál, ṣo-o mario a tsjes, tamasea tallochon tump'o babosa, patoach o zijsja, pautas, ṣo-o kamabo mauchus torro boa.
standard: Abá channumma, all'airien o boesum gagil mabarra, maalál, ṣoo mario a tsjes, tamasea tallochon tump'o babosa, patoach o zijsja, pautas, ṣoo kamabo mauchus torro boa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_32_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Now I understand the matter. Certainly, if it did not rain, if the sun did not rise, all things would perish; trees, herbs, cows, horses, deer, and men, would all die.
form: Ka mab'o pia: oedan, sja alli moetas, alli tummoach a zijsja, kamamachá tapos o baron, baziep, binnan, loan, a babosa.
standard: Ka mab'o pia: oedan, sja alli moetas, alli tummoach a zijsja, kamamachá tapos o baron, baziep, binnan, loan, a babosa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_32_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Now it is proved that heaven and all its lights have been made by some Being, as also the earth and the sea.
form: Ka inipait'o pia, alla boesum ṣo-o tapos choa rará ka-inerienṣar innai de roman-ech, maibas o ta channumma, ṣo-o abas.
standard: Ka inipait'o pia, alla boesum ṣoo tapos choa rará kainerienṣar innai de romanech, maibas o ta channumma, ṣoo abas.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_33_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, you have not yet proved that heaven, earth, and the sea, are Jehovah's own works, as you just now declared.
form: Mai, acho ijo pinaita, alla boesum, a ta, a abas paga maunis a taap o Jehova ja Deos, maibas ijo pala naassa-da.
standard: Mai, acho ijo pinaita, alla boesum, a ta, a abas paga maunis a taap o Jehova ja Deos, maibas ijo pala naassada.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_33_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What! are they not God's own works? Whose works are they then? Can man do those things?
form: Oedan! sja alli maunis a taap o Deos, tomm'ija tataap paga micho, ja babosa mab'o merien aicho-ies?
standard: Oedan! sja alli maunis a taap o Deos, tomm'ija tataap paga micho, ja babosa mab'o merien aichoies?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_34_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: May it not be that haibos has made them all?
form: Matalam ta haibos minerien o mini tapos ai.
standard: Matalam ta haibos minerien o mini tapos ai.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_34_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Do you think haibos is the creator of heaven, the earth, and the sea?
form: Ja poetat o haibos airien o boesum, o ta, a abás ijonoë?
standard: Ja poetat o haibos airien o boesum, o ta, a abás ijonoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_35_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I think so.
form: Na-a poetatṣar.
standard: Naa poetatṣar.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_35_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: That, therefore, haibos is the true God?
form: Masini papaga Deos gagil ta haibos?
standard: Masini papaga Deos gagil ta haibos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_36_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Perhaps he is.
form: Matalam paga.
standard: Matalam paga.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_36_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Can you prove that, or do you only imagine this?
form: Ja mab'o pait'o ailoë, ja poetat o baakṣar?
standard: Ja mab'o pait'o ailoë, ja poetat o baakṣar?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_37_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I follow the ancient belief of my forefathers.
form: Na-a ummior o autat na-a boeboeno anibaas.
standard: Naa ummior o autat naa boeboeno anibaas.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_37_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: That is a very foolish idea or belief.
form: Autat o baak ja micho.
standard: Autat o baak ja micho.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_38_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: How do you prove that?
form: Moed'ijo pait'o aicho?
standard: Moed'ijo pait'o aicho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_38_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Your forefathers have not known the true God.
form: Oa boeboe-no minautsiri o gagil o Deos.
standard: Oa boeboeno minautsiri o gagil o Deos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_39_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why?
form: Inaunumma?
standard: Inaunumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_39_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They have been ignorant of the written Word of God.
form: Minautsiri o ranied o Deos kabinidoan dechonoë.
standard: Minautsiri o ranied o Deos kabinidoan dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_40_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, then, is there a written Word of God?
form: Mai numma, ja paga kabinidoan ranied o Deos?
standard: Mai numma, ja paga kabinidoan ranied o Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_40_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, there is.
form: Paḡána.
standard: Paḡána.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_41_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What kind of written Word is that?
form: Numma kabinidoan ranied ja micho?
standard: Numma kabinidoan ranied ja micho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_41_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: A Word, or divine declaration, in which God speaks of His own being or person.
form: Atite o al'o Deos innai choa micho ḡa ja boa.
standard: Atite o al'o Deos innai choa micho ḡa ja boa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_42_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Has God Himself made His own person known?
form: Ja maunis pinab'o choa boa ta Deos?
standard: Ja maunis pinab'o choa boa ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_42_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, He has.
form: Hena.
standard: Hena.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_43_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: When?
form: Aninumma?
standard: Aninumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_43_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Long ago, from the beginning, when all things were made.
form: Ani milip, innai aisas'o inerien o mini tapos ai.
standard: Ani milip, innai aisas'o inerien o mini tapos ai.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_44_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: To which people did God reveal His Word?
form: Tomma-da cho pinab'o choa ranied ta Deos?
standard: Tommada cho pinab'o choa ranied ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_44_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: To the Jewish people, and to the righteous prophets, who have been of old, as Abraham, Jacob, Moses, Samuel, David; who received the divine doctrine, so that they, as intelligent teachers, might instruct the common people.
form: Chono i Judea, ṣo-o ta ma-aijaab ma-abisse-bissé tsjes anibaas, ta Abraham, ta Jacob, ta Moses, ta Samuel, ta David, tamasea minarach o atil o Deos, alla maibas o ma-atil o mabada tsjes allecho pattil o chono baak decho-noë.
standard: Chono i Judea, ṣoo ta maaijaab maabissebissé tsjes anibaas, ta Abraham, ta Jacob, ta Moses, ta Samuel, ta David, tamasea minarach o atil o Deos, alla maibas o maatil o mabada tsjes allecho pattil o chono baak dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_45_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why does God so earnestly desire to declare and reveal Himself?
form: Annumma maddobor maunis-o-ala ṣo-o pab'o choa boa ta Deos?
standard: Annumma maddobor maunis o ala ṣoo pab'o choa boa ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_45_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Because our understanding is void, and bereft of the knowledge of God.
form: Inau marotul o ab'o Deos torroa ṣaan.
standard: Inau marotul o ab'o Deos torroa ṣaan.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_46_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: And do we not of ourselves know the true God?
form: Ja torro alli madarram o Deos o gagil innai autat torroa micho?
standard: Ja torro alli madarram o Deos o gagil innai autat torroa micho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_46_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: No. Although this entire structure from top to bottom testifies of its Creator, and proves that there is a certain Person or Spirit, the most intelligent, the most powerful, who has made and adorned all these things; though His wisdom and power are seen, still we can by no means see who this Creator is. The Creator would remain quite hidden, if God had not added His Word given to us so many years ago, and if He had not given us an image of His own person in His written Word.
form: Pa: pagatomma tapos o tataap o mini innai babo pana rapó pait'o cho'airien, alla paga charri o boa ja tsjes, kummasjies a maachéer, a ma-abarra, tamasea minerien ṣo-o pinaal-lá o mini tapos ai pagatomma itan choa aba, a barra, pagaga aban chaddai, tomm'ija Airien o mini, kapapoetautachṣar o auchos ma-acharrieb Airien o ai, sja alli pinachip o choa ranied ta Deos, sja inni cho'atite kabinidoan anibaas alli pinattas o tatchier o choa micho boa.
standard: Pa: pagatomma tapos o tataap o mini innai babo pana rapó pait'o cho'airien, alla paga charri o boa ja tsjes, kummasjies a maachéer, a maabarra, tamasea minerien ṣoo pinaallá o mini tapos ai pagatomma itan choa aba, a barra, pagaga aban chaddai, tomm'ija Airien o mini, kapapoetautachṣar o auchos maacharrieb Airien o ai, sja alli pinachip o choa ranied ta Deos, sja inni cho'atite kabinidoan anibaas alli pinattas o tatchier o choa micho boa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_47_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why does God remain so completely hidden?
form: Inaunumma macharrieb ta Deos?
standard: Inaunumma macharrieb ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_47_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: He is quite a spiritual Being, whom we cannot see nor handle, as we can our bodies; God has no bones, sinews, blood or flesh, nor has He a body.
form: Paga tsjes o auchos icho, tamasea pa itan, pa ṣiddo-on maibas o bogṣar; pa oot, oḡḡach, taḡḡa, boa, bogṣar ta Deos.
standard: Paga tsjes o auchos icho, tamasea pa itan, pa ṣiddoon maibas o bogṣar; pa oot, oḡḡach, taḡḡa, boa, bogṣar ta Deos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_48_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Is haibos also a spirit?
form: Ta haibos paga channumma baak o tsjes?
standard: Ta haibos paga channumma baak o tsjes?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_48_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You do not know haibos, nor his malignity.
form: Ijo mautsiri o haibos, ṣo-o cho'arapies.
standard: Ijo mautsiri o haibos, ṣoo cho'arapies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_49_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What! is haibos wicked?
form: Numma, ja rapies ta haibos?
standard: Numma, ja rapies ta haibos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_49_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Certainly. Have not your forefathers, who lived many years ago, and do you not yourselves, murmur and grumble about haibos? Do you not complain that he beats you and makes you ill? Do you not call him the wicked haibos?
form: Oedan, ja oa boeboe-no anibaas, ṣo-o ijo channumma alli makarrichi tallochon i haibos, alli poddodo inau ṣimioch ṣo-o pach'ijo madig, alli pattonan ja icho rapies haibos?
standard: Oedan, ja oa boeboeno anibaas, ṣoo ijo channumma alli makarrichi tallochon i haibos, alli poddodo inau ṣimioch ṣoo pach'ijo madig, alli pattonan ja icho rapies haibos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_50_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Perhaps we make a mistake.
form: Matalam poelakies ja namo.
standard: Matalam poelakies ja namo.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_50_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Not at all; he is decidedly wicked and malignant. Therefore haibos is called the wicked one; that is to say, he is a ringleader in rebellion, and the evil-doer.
form: Maini: pagá gagil arapies icho, ṣo-o o auchos rapies tsjes. Inau micho attonannan ta haibos rapies ai, micho a pattite, ma-akakossi a ma-arapies?
standard: Maini: pagá gagil arapies icho, ṣoo o auchos rapies tsjes. Inau micho attonannan ta haibos rapies ai, micho a pattite, maakakossi a maarapies?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_51_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: We call him also the good haibos.
form: Torro pattonan icho channumma mario haibos.
standard: Torro pattonan icho channumma mario haibos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_51_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What! is haibos bad, and is he good too? If he is bad, why do you praise the evil-doer? If he is good, why do you murmur and complain about his malignity?
form: Numma, ja rapies haibos, ṣo-o mario channumma ta haibos, sja rapies haibos, inaunumma ṣummo-al o rapies ai? Sja mario haibos, inaunumma makarrichi ṣo-o poddodo o cho'arapies?
standard: Numma, ja rapies haibos, ṣoo mario channumma ta haibos, sja rapies haibos, inaunumma ṣummoal o rapies ai? Sja mario haibos, inaunumma makarrichi ṣoo poddodo o cho'arapies?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_52_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You have just now praised the Creator of heaven, of the earth and sea, for His bountifulness.
form: Ani tinnaam ijo ṣummoal o Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas inau cho'al-ál a tataap a rio.
standard: Ani tinnaam ijo ṣummoal o Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas inau cho'alál a tataap a rio.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_52_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: It is but right and proper that we should praise the Creator, who loves man so dearly, and who constantly thinks of us; who causes the sun to rise, who sends down rain upon the fields, and every year causes the fruits thereof to be abundant.
form: Mabisse micho, ṣo-o makkesjap alla namo madás i Airien o ai-oë, tamasea masini maukat o babosa, tallochon tump'i namoa, patoach o zijsja, pautas o tsinaap, ṣo-o pabo'o inochan atatta baas.
standard: Mabisse micho, ṣoo makkesjap alla namo madás i Airien o aioë, tamasea masini maukat o babosa, tallochon tump'i namoa, patoach o zijsja, pautas o tsinaap, ṣoo pabo'o inochan atatta baas.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_53_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: We praise haibos in the same way, and call him the good haibos.
form: Masini namo ṣummoal i haibos channumma, ṣo-o pattonan ja mario haibos.
standard: Masini namo ṣummoal i haibos channumma, ṣoo pattonan ja mario haibos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_53_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You are quite wrong; just as if you were to say black is white, This name belongs to God alone. In that way, and in your ignorance, you ascribe to haibos the honour which is due to God; and because the blessings of God are not known to you.
form: Mauchus poelakies imoa; maibas moa pattonan o ma-orum, ma-ausi. Naan o mini makkesjap ta Deos ma-akammichiṣar. Masini inau otsiri, ṣo-o inau acho madarram o tataap o rio o Deos, imo pe'o adas, kamaunis a Deos, ta haibos-ech.
standard: Mauchus poelakies imoa; maibas moa pattonan o maorum, maausi. Naan o mini makkesjap ta Deos maakammichiṣar. Masini inau otsiri, ṣoo inau acho madarram o tataap o rio o Deos, imo pe'o adas, kamaunis a Deos, ta haibosech.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_54_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: According to your declaration, the belief in haibos and in Adam is vain, and a deception of haibos.
form: Matalam maibas pait'ijo autat inni ta haibos, inni Adam, paga baak, ṣo-o sasall'o haibos-ech.
standard: Matalam maibas pait'ijo autat inni ta haibos, inni Adam, paga baak, ṣoo sasall'o haibosech.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_54_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: That is true. I know his deceitfulness, for just as in the beginning, when all things were created, he deceived the first man called Adam, as well as all his posterity, and many more of our sojourners in the world, so, also, has he in former years deceived your forefathers and their posterity, just as he has deceived all the inhabitants of this island, whereby they now believe the words of a lying old slut, and put their confidence in the song of a little bird, bearing, as our first forefather did, the name of Adam.
form: Gagil micho. Mab'o in'o choa sasalla, maibas inni aisas'o inerien o mini tapos ai, icho pinaulakies o babos'o pesasa tamasea naan ta Adam, ṣo-o choa sjiem o sjiem, tapos roman azjies de babo ta, masini channumm'ani milip icho pinaulakies oa boeboe-no anibaas, ṣo-o choa sjiem, tapos o cho de borroch o ta mini, alla decho poetat inni ranied o maṣini ma-attattosik, alla poetat inni babo o kotsi mampa-dech, o ai marach o naan ta Adam, maibas o torro boeboe-no pesasa.
standard: Gagil micho. Mab'o in'o choa sasalla, maibas inni aisas'o inerien o mini tapos ai, icho pinaulakies o babos'o pesasa tamasea naan ta Adam, ṣoo choa sjiem o sjiem, tapos roman azjies de babo ta, masini channumm'ani milip icho pinaulakies oa boeboeno anibaas, ṣoo choa sjiem, tapos o cho de borroch o ta mini, alla decho poetat inni ranied o maṣini maattattosik, alla poetat inni babo o kotsi mampadech, o ai marach o naan ta Adam, maibas o torro boeboeno pesasa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_55_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Haibos has declared that he makes even Adam to sing and to prophesy.
form: Ka pinala ta haibos all'icho pábo ṣo-o meápab'i ta Adam.
standard: Ka pinala ta haibos all'icho pábo ṣoo meápab'i ta Adam.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_55_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: He lies. The birds sing without discrimination. Is, now, such a little bird the prophet of haibos? Perhaps he has even imitated the singing of this little bird in order to deceive the people of Ternern and other inhabitants of this island.
form: Tummosik icho. Mampa po baakṣar. Ja kotsi mampa masini paga ma-aijaab o haibos? Matalam icho maunis tsinimichier o bábo o kotsi mampa mini, alla summall'i Ternern, ṣo-o roman azjies de borroch o ta mini.
standard: Tummosik icho. Mampa po baakṣar. Ja kotsi mampa masini paga maaijaab o haibos? Matalam icho maunis tsinimichier o bábo o kotsi mampa mini, alla summall'i Ternern, ṣoo roman azjies de borroch o ta mini.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_56_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What has been the object of haibos in giving the name of Adam to this little bird?
form: Inonumma ta haibos pinatonan o kotsi mampa mini Adam?
standard: Inonumma ta haibos pinatonan o kotsi mampa mini Adam?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_56_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: That by thus mocking the first man the villain might lead him into the path of error.
