form: Masini rapies a mannach'o babos'o pesasa, o ai pinaulabies icho.
standard: Masini rapies a mannach'o babos'o pesasa, o ai pinaulabies icho.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_57_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: If haibos is not the-true God, what is he, then?
form: Sja pagaga Deos o gagil ta haibos, numm'ija icho?
standard: Sja pagaga Deos o gagil ta haibos, numm'ija icho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_57_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Has haibos not told you who he is?
form: Ja alli pinab'o choa boa ta haibos?
standard: Ja alli pinab'o choa boa ta haibos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_58_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Haibos says that he has formed man, that he causes the sun to rise, and that he fertilises the fruits of the fields.
form: Machó ta haibos all'icho merien o babosa, patoach o zijsja, pautas, ṣo-o pabo'o inochan.
standard: Machó ta haibos all'icho merien o babosa, patoach o zijsja, pautas, ṣoo pabo'o inochan.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_58_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: All lies! Just so the old serpent poisons man. Like an ape he imitates God and deceives men, so that they may believe that he is the true God, that they may fear him and sacrifice to him.
form: Tapos ja tattosik! Masini raras a ibien aicho sumbach o babosa. Pazigal'i ta Deos, ṣo-o summall'o cho, alla poetat icho Deos o gagil, alla me'il ṣo-o paan icho.
standard: Tapos ja tattosik! Masini raras a ibien aicho sumbach o babosa. Pazigal'i ta Deos, ṣoo summall'o cho, alla poetat icho Deos o gagil, alla me'il ṣoo paan icho.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_59_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, could you now say what kind of being haibos is?
form: Mai, ja mab'o pattite i-jono-ë numm'i-ja haibos?
standard: Mai, ja mab'o pattite ijonoë numm'ija haibos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_59_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, I can.
form: Mabána.
standard: Mabána.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_60_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: By what means do you know him?
form: Innainumm'i-jo mab'o icho-ech?
standard: Innainumm'ijo mab'o ichoech?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_60_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: God has depicted haibos in His written Word, and tells us how wicked he is, so that we may be on our guard against his deceitfulness.
form: Ta Deos pinattas o haibos inni choa ranied kabinidoan, ṣo-o tummassal o cho'arapies, alla torro mame-il o choa sasalla.
standard: Ta Deos pinattas o haibos inni choa ranied kabinidoan, ṣoo tummassal o cho'arapies, alla torro mameil o choa sasalla.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_61_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: How so? I wish to know.
form: Moedaṣar? Ipabána.
standard: Moedaṣar? Ipabána.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_61_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, then, in the beginning, when heaven was finally completed, God created many thousands of incorporeal servitors who were very volatile, quick, strong, and just, giving them a dwelling in heaven, so that they might behold His dominion, and receive His commands. The name of these servitors is Angelus, that is, servants and serving spirits of God. They neither eat, nor drink, nor do they sleep; they have no offspring as man in general has; they are many in number, yea, they are innumerable; they live on for ever, and will never die. To praise God is their desire and delight, so also to obey His word. Haibos was formerly also a good angel, and a just servant of God; but afterwards, he, and many of his fellows, rebelled against God. They envied His vast power and dominion, they desired to become equal with God, endeavoured to establish a dominion of their own, and to follow their own will. It is in this way that haibos and all his followers sinned in the beginning, and still remain malicious and rebellious.
form: Masiniṣar: ani pesasa, ka-inoob o boesum, ta Deos minerien o aran ma-arotul o bog, mapan mama-achpil a tschiet eis, mauchus ma-acheerna, ma-aamgách, ma-abarra, ma-abisse a tsjes; ṣo-o pinaṣos' inni boesum-ech dechonoë, alia mit'o choa chachimit ṣo-o ummoob o cho'attilo. Naan o aran o mini paga ta Angelus, michoṣar a pattite, aran o Deos baak o tsjes. Alli man, micham, ṣummarra, alli pausjiem decho maibas o babosa, kamatasasna, pa tochen inau mauchus matasas, machonṣar morich, alli mach'ija, choa airab a aukat paga madas i ta Deos, ṣo-o ummior tallochon o cho'atite. Ta haibos ani tinnaam channumma mario Angelus, ṣo-o aran o Deos mabisse a tsjes, kasaghá icho, ṣo-o ma-atasás choa ara pesas'o kummossi i ta Deos choa Airien, masannan o choa chachimit matoto dechonoë, pazigal'i ta Deos, ṣo-o ṣummad'o maunis a chachimit, all'ummior o maunis choa airab. Masini ta haibos ṣo-o tapos choa ara pinarapies ani pesasa, ṣo-o machonṣar rapies a ma-akakossi.
standard: Masiniṣar: ani pesasa, kainoob o boesum, ta Deos minerien o aran maarotul o bog, mapan mamaachpil a tschiet eis, mauchus maacheerna, maaamgách, maabarra, maabisse a tsjes; ṣoo pinaṣos' inni boesumech dechonoë, alia mit'o choa chachimit ṣoo ummoob o cho'attilo. Naan o aran o mini paga ta Angelus, michoṣar a pattite, aran o Deos baak o tsjes. Alli man, micham, ṣummarra, alli pausjiem decho maibas o babosa, kamatasasna, pa tochen inau mauchus matasas, machonṣar morich, alli mach'ija, choa airab a aukat paga madas i ta Deos, ṣoo ummior tallochon o cho'atite. Ta haibos ani tinnaam channumma mario Angelus, ṣoo aran o Deos mabisse a tsjes, kasaghá icho, ṣoo maatasás choa ara pesas'o kummossi i ta Deos choa Airien, masannan o choa chachimit matoto dechonoë, pazigal'i ta Deos, ṣoo ṣummad'o maunis a chachimit, all'ummior o maunis choa airab. Masini ta haibos ṣoo tapos choa ara pinarapies ani pesasa, ṣoo machonṣar rapies a maakakossi.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_62_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Do they not repent of their rebellion?
form: Ja alli machi'o kakossi choa tsjes-oë?
standard: Ja alli machi'o kakossi choa tsjesoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_62_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: No, they persist in their rebellion and wickedness, which are continually increasing.
form: Maini, kamoddon o tsjes dechonoë, ṣo-o moab tallochon cho'arapies.
standard: Maini, kamoddon o tsjes dechonoë, ṣoo moab tallochon cho'arapies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_63_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Has God forgiven them their rebellion?
form: Ja ta Deos minabono choa kakossi?
standard: Ja ta Deos minabono choa kakossi?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_63_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: By no means; He will punish it terribly.
form: Pagaga chaddai. Kamauchus chummote i dechonoë.
standard: Pagaga chaddai. Kamauchus chummote i dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_64_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: In what way?
form: Masanno?
standard: Masanno?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_64_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: On account of his disobedience, haibos and all his fellows have been cast out of heaven.
form: Inau kakossi initis innai boesum ta haibos ṣo-o tapos choa ara.
standard: Inau kakossi initis innai boesum ta haibos ṣoo tapos choa ara.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_65_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: After those wicked servants had been cast out, have they been set at liberty?
form: Ka ochal itis rapies aran ai, ja binarrasan dechonoë?
standard: Ka ochal itis rapies aran ai, ja binarrasan dechonoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_65_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: No, they are all kept in bonds, in order to be eternally punished in the pit of fire, called Gehenna.
form: Maini: kakoemen ja patapos, inochote-in taulaulan lallum chauch o chau, o ai attonannan gehenna.
standard: Maini: kakoemen ja patapos, ino chotein taulaulan lallum chauch o chau, o ai attonannan gehenna.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_66_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Does God really threaten to punish haibos in that manner?
form: Ja gagil ta Deos lummallak o pachote i ta haibos masini?
standard: Ja gagil ta Deos lummallak o pachote i ta haibos masini?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_66_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, certainly.
form: Gagilna.
standard: Gagilna.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_67_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Oh, frightful! Woe unto haibos and his fellows!
form: Tanaas! Anana i haibos, ṣo-o choa arada!
standard: Tanaas! Anana i haibos, ṣoo choa arada!

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_67_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They are sorely afraid of such frightful anger, and tremble.
form: Decho mauchus me-il o rais talcho a mato, ṣo-o matirtir.
standard: Decho mauchus meil o rais talcho a mato, ṣoo matirtir.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_68_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why do they not appease God?
form: Talla alli maborr'i ta Deos dechonoë?
standard: Talla alli maborr'i ta Deos dechonoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_68_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: God refuses to be merciful unto them.
form: Madaddo mabono decho ta Deos.
standard: Madaddo mabono decho ta Deos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_69_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Why?
form: Inaunumma?
standard: Inaunumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_69_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They are stiff-necked, and their wickedness is too great.
form: Decho maraas a tsjes, ṣo-o mauchus mato cho'arapies.
standard: Decho maraas a tsjes, ṣoo mauchus mato cho'arapies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_70_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: In what does their wickedness consist?
form: Numm'ija cho'arapies?
standard: Numm'ija cho'arapies?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_70_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: In disobeying God and doing evil to men.
form: Kummossi i ta Deos, ṣo-o parapies o babosa.
standard: Kummossi i ta Deos, ṣoo parapies o babosa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_71_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Is that so? Do they harbour enmity and envy against men?
form: Tanaas! ja kamazjies ṣo-o masannan o babosa channumma dechonoë?
standard: Tanaas! ja kamazjies ṣoo masannan o babosa channumma dechonoë?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_71_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, because they feel enmity against God, they also feel envy that we men love God and obey His commands.
form: Hena: inau kamazjies i ta Deos choa tsjes-oë, decho masannan torro babosa maukat i ta Deos, ṣo-o ummior o cho'atillo.
standard: Hena: inau kamazjies i ta Deos choa tsjesoë, decho masannan torro babosa maukat i ta Deos, ṣoo ummior o cho'atillo.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_72_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Perhaps they would much like that he and we should jointly rise against God?
form: Matalam choa airab alla decho ṣo-o torro babosa karri-kakossi i ta Deos?
standard: Matalam choa airab alla decho ṣoo torro babosa karrikakossi i ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_72_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, they would very much like that.
form: Hena mauchus merab o micho dechonoë.
standard: Hena mauchus merab o micho dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_73_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: I think that you complained a short time ago of haibos, and accused him that he led Adam, the first man, into error. How is that?
form: Katumpa ina, ijo poddodo ani naassada, ṣo-o makarrichi i haibos inau icho pinaulakies i ta Adam babos'o pesasa: moeda micho?
standard: Katumpa ina, ijo poddodo ani naassada, ṣoo makarrichi i haibos inau icho pinaulakies i ta Adam babos'o pesasa: moeda micho?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_73_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: From the very beginning, haibos has done much harm, and he does so still. His real name is Satan, which means an enemy, one filled with envy. Jesus Christ, the Son of God, calls haibos an enemy, a murderer, and the father of lies. It is haibos, the rebellious ringleader, who has induced man to rebel against Him. Our first forefathers were perfect and righteous. God had made two persons, a man and a woman; the name of the man was Adam, the name of the woman was Eve. From these two persons all men and generations of the earth have sprung. When they first were created, they knew no evil; they did not know what disobedience was; they loved God; they were desirous to do what was right and proper, and to obey God's commands. Haibos, on witnessing the love and peace existing between God and man, became very jealous; he came to tempt our first forefathers; he poisoned their minds like a serpent, and deceived them with his lies, so that they followed in the steps of his disobedience.
form: Ta haibos mauchus pinarapies o babos'ani pesasa, ṣo-o machonsar parapies. Choa naan o gagil paga ta Ṣaitan, michoṣar a pattite, ázjies-in ṣo-o ma-assannan. Sjiem badd'o Deos ta Jesus Christus pattonan o haibos, ázjies-in maach'o cho, ṣo-o tamau o tattosik. Ta haibos ma-akakossi ai, tamasea linummal'i kakossi o babosa. Kainerienṣar o auchos mario, ma-abisse a tsjes torroa boeboe-no pesasa. Ta Deos minerien decho narroa choṣar, sjam a ṣini, naan o sjam paga Adam, naan o ṣini, Eva. Innai choa boa tsinummoach tapos o cho, ṣo-o tupponodon de ta. Ka bao inerienṣar dechonoë, acho mab'o arapies, acho mab'o kummossi, maukat choa tsjes i ta Deos, maukat o tataap o babisse, ṣo-o ummior o atillono Deos. Ta haibos, inau mit'o aukat ṣo-o aborra tuppach o Deos a babosa, mauchus masannan sai lummall'i ta Eva, ṣo-o Adam torroa micho boeboeno pesasa, maibas ibien sumbach o choa tsjes-oë, ṣo-o summall'i decho o choa tattosik, alla tsimichier o kakossi o haibos dechonoë.
standard: Ta haibos mauchus pinarapies o babos'ani pesasa, ṣoo machonsar parapies. Choa naan o gagil paga ta Ṣaitan, michoṣar a pattite, ázjiesin ṣoo maassannan. Sjiem badd'o Deos ta Jesus Christus pattonan o haibos, ázjiesin maach'o cho, ṣoo tamau o tattosik. Ta haibos maakakossi ai, tamasea linummal'i kakossi o babosa. Kainerienṣar o auchos mario, maabisse a tsjes torroa boeboeno pesasa. Ta Deos minerien decho narroa choṣar, sjam a ṣini, naan o sjam paga Adam, naan o ṣini, Eva. Innai choa boa tsinummoach tapos o cho, ṣoo tupponodon de ta. Ka bao inerienṣar dechonoë, acho mab'o arapies, acho mab'o kummossi, maukat choa tsjes i ta Deos, maukat o tataap o babisse, ṣoo ummior o atillono Deos. Ta haibos, inau mit'o aukat ṣoo aborra tuppach o Deos a babosa, mauchus masannan sai lummall'i ta Eva, ṣoo Adam torroa micho boeboeno pesasa, maibas ibien sumbach o choa tsjesoë, ṣoo summall'i decho o choa tattosik, alla tsimichier o kakossi o haibos dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_74_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Well, has man also disobeyed God?
form: Mai numma, ja babosa channumma kinummossi i ta Deos?
standard: Mai numma, ja babosa channumma kinummossi i ta Deos?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_74_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes. Haibos has deceived Adam and Eve, and led them to disobey.
form: Hena. Ta haibos pinaulakies i ta Adam a Eva, ṣo-o pinakossi o choa boa.
standard: Hena. Ta haibos pinaulakies i ta Adam a Eva, ṣoo pinakossi o choa boa.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_75_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Did their posterity also transgress?
form: Ja choa sjiem o sjiem kinummossi channumma?
standard: Ja choa sjiem o sjiem kinummossi channumma?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_75_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, all the children of men have in the beginning transgressed in Adam and Eve, and have imitated their disobedience, just as they imitated the disobedience of haibos.
form: Hena, tapos sisjiem o babosa kinummossi ani pesasa inni ta Adam a Eva, ṣo-o tsimichier o choa kakossi, maibas tsinimichier o Kakossi o haibos dechonoë.
standard: Hena, tapos sisjiem o babosa kinummossi ani pesasa inni ta Adam a Eva, ṣoo tsimichier o choa kakossi, maibas tsinimichier o Kakossi o haibos dechonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_76_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: What! are all the children of men evil-doers and trespassers?
form: Oedan! Ja ma-arapies a ma-akakossi tapos o babosa?
standard: Oedan! Ja maarapies a maakakossi tapos o babosa?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_76_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: They have all transgressed, and are born in sin.
form: Kinummossi ja patapos, ṣo-o ausjimen inni arapies.
standard: Kinummossi ja patapos, ṣoo ausjimen inni arapies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_77_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Does haibos rather persevere in leading men to disobey God and to tempt them to commit wickedness?
form: Ja ta haibos machonṣar o pákossi o babosa, ṣo-o lummal'i arapies?
standard: Ja ta haibos machonṣar o pákossi o babosa, ṣoo lummal'i arapies?

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_77_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, he goes to and fro, like a serpent, to poison us. He causes evil thoughts to arise in the heart, extinguishes the fear of God, as also knowledge of and faith in God, harasses the mind, so that it is filled with doubt and vain fears; thus it believes in haibos, in his deceitfulness, and lying superstitions. He does all he possibly can to increase man's ignorance concerning God, drunkenness, murder, adultery, envy, deceit, lies, theft, disobedience, obstinacy, and every wickedness.
form: Hena: pallidollido maibos o ibien, alla sumbach i narao. Pisor inni tsjes o tattuppau rapies. Potup o ikkil o Deos, o aba, o autat inni ta Deos. Paulakies o tsjes, alla marmimi a mikkil o baak; alla poetat inni haibos, inni choa sasalla, choa aríen o ma-atattosik. Maddobor ja icho alla moab otsiri o ta Deos, ma-audum a tsjes, árab, ách'o cho, chachod, sannan, sasalla, tattosik, áchab, kakossi, ma-araas a tsjes, ṣo-o tapos o arapies.
standard: Hena: pallidollido maibos o ibien, alla sumbach i narao. Pisor inni tsjes o tattuppau rapies. Potup o ikkil o Deos, o aba, o autat inni ta Deos. Paulakies o tsjes, alla marmimi a mikkil o baak; alla poetat inni haibos, inni choa sasalla, choa aríen o maatattosik. Maddobor ja icho alla moab otsiri o ta Deos, maaudum a tsjes, árab, ách'o cho, chachod, sannan, sasalla, tattosik, áchab, kakossi, maaraas a tsjes, ṣoo tapos o arapies.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_78_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: However much you may continue to dissuade us, our souls entirely cleave to haibos, because we are long accustomed to him.
form: Pagatomm'ijonoë machonṣar o ummaddo; ani milip torro madarram i ta haibos, ṣo-o mauchus mikkap icho torroa tsjes-oë.
standard: Pagatomm'ijonoë machonṣar o ummaddo; ani milip torro madarram i ta haibos, ṣoo mauchus mikkap icho torroa tsjesoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_78_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: You have not known his wickedness.
form: Minautsiri o cho'arapies imonoë.
standard: Minautsiri o cho'arapies imonoë.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_79_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: We fear to reject him; perhaps he will be angry with us, and do us harm.
form: Torro mikkil o tummis icho, depa makabol ṣai parapies i namo.
standard: Torro mikkil o tummis icho, depa makabol ṣai parapies i namo.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_79_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: If ye will continue to follow haibos, ye forsake God, and become His enemy.
form: Sja merab o ummior o haibos, imo lummido i ta Deos, ṣo-o kamazjies icho.
standard: Sja merab o ummior o haibos, imo lummido i ta Deos, ṣoo kamazjies icho.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_80_favorlanger
notes: Favorlanger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: Yes, but we fear too much the wrath of haibos.
form: Oedan, mauchus torro me-il o rais o ta haibos.
standard: Oedan, mauchus torro meil o rais o ta haibos.

section_title: Dialogue Between a Favorlanger and a Dutch Stranger
label: item_80_stranger
notes: Dutch stranger turn split at printed speaker labels; boundary number and label omitted
translation: And do ye not fear the wrath of God much more? If ye will follow after God, He will trample haibos under your feet, and take you under His own care. Without God's permission haibos has no power to harm men. Ye have feared and sacrificed to him enough; flee from haibos as a poisonous serpent. Woe unto all who adhere to haibos, for the wrath of God and the punishment of hell-fire continually threaten to overtake them. To conclude our conversation, take heed to bear in mind the things that have been said to you, and remember these three things:- In the first place, I have proved that heaven, earth, and the sea, have not always, or from all eternity, existed of themselves; they have been made by some being or other. In proof, I have spoken of the adornment of heaven, and I have also said that heaven, with all its lights, is subservient to the dominion of another Being, who commands them to render their services to the earth, to the fruits of the field belonging to man, and to the beasts of the field. Secondly, I have explained that Jehovah, or Deos, is the Creator of heaven, earth, and the sea; that it is He who has made and adorned all things. From hence it follows that He alone is the true God. Thirdly, I have laid bare to you the deceit of haibos, who simulates the true God, and who has misled your forefathers from the beginning, so that they believed in haibos, in Adam, and have listened to the words of lying old women, the prophetesses of haibos, who have taught these inhabitants of Ternern, and other inhabitants of this island, to follow after vain superstitions, in order to put you hereafter on your guard against his deceit, and make you believe the words of the true God, to whom belong all dominion, and power, and praise, for ever and ever. Amen.
form: Ja alli maso mikkil o rais o Deos? Sja a-ummior i ta Deos, tatummallas o haibos icho de rapó oa aṣiel, ṣo-o mamaladik imoa. Alli mabarra ja icho parapies o babosa, sja alli pauss'icho ta Deos. Chauḡe mikkil, chauḡe paan icho; obea innai ta haibos, maibas innai ibien o boesum. Anana i tapos chono ai ka machonṣar o mikkap i ta haibos, inau rais o ta Deos, ṣo-o chachalt o chau Gehenna taulaulan marior i decho. Alla na-a poṣisi o pattite, assánman-a, aladikk'o ranied i tsjes, ṣo-o tuppá natorroa da tuppono mini:- Ka pesasa, pinaita ina alla boesum, o ta, a abas alli pinaga maunis o taulalan; ka inerienṣar innai-de roman aicho-ech. Na-a pait'o mini innai a-lá o boesum, ṣo-o channumma, inau boesum a tapos choa rará ummior o chachimit o roman-ech; tamasea pauloan aicho-ies, ṣo-o pattillo aran o ta mini, o inochan o cho, o binnan de bonna. Ka narroa, na-a pinaba, alla ta Jehova ja Deos paga airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, tamasea minerien ṣo-o pinaal-lá o mini tapos ai, innai-numma ummior all'icho makammichi gagil o Deos. Ka natorroa, na-a innummillaḡ o sasall'o haibos-ech, tamasea pazigal'i ta Deos o gagil, ṣo-o pinaulakies oa boeboeno anibaas, alla pinoetatt dechonoë inni haibos, inni Adam, ṣo-o tump'o ranied o maṣini ma-atattosik, o ai pinaga ma-aijaab o haibos, ṣo-o pinattil i Ternern, a roman azjies de borroch o ta mini ummior o aríen o baak, alla rummi-es mame-il o choa sasalla, ṣo-o poetautat inni ranied o Deos o gagil, maunis o ai chachimit o tapos, a barra, ṣo-o adás, taulaulan, Amen. Ṣisi o karri-atite.
standard: Ja alli maso mikkil o rais o Deos? Sja aummior i ta Deos, tatummallas o haibos icho de rapó oa aṣiel, ṣoo mamaladik imoa. Alli mabarra ja icho parapies o babosa, sja alli pauss'icho ta Deos. Chauḡe mikkil, chauḡe paan icho; obea innai ta haibos, maibas innai ibien o boesum. Anana i tapos chono ai ka machonṣar o mikkap i ta haibos, inau rais o ta Deos, ṣoo chachalt o chau Gehenna taulaulan marior i decho. Alla naa poṣisi o pattite, assánmana, aladikk'o ranied i tsjes, ṣoo tuppá natorroa da tuppono mini:- Ka pesasa, pinaita ina alla boesum, o ta, a abas alli pinaga maunis o taulalan; ka inerienṣar innai de roman aichoech. Naa pait'o mini innai alá o boesum, ṣoo channumma, inau boesum a tapos choa rará ummior o chachimit o romanech; tamasea pauloan aichoies, ṣoo pattillo aran o ta mini, o inochan o cho, o binnan de bonna. Ka narroa, naa pinaba, alla ta Jehova ja Deos paga airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, tamasea minerien ṣoo pinaallá o mini tapos ai, innainumma ummior all'icho makammichi gagil o Deos. Ka natorroa, naa innummillaḡ o sasall'o haibosech, tamasea pazigal'i ta Deos o gagil, ṣoo pinaulakies oa boeboeno anibaas, alla pinoetatt dechonoë inni haibos, inni Adam, ṣoo tump'o ranied o maṣini maatattosik, o ai pinaga maaijaab o haibos, ṣoo pinattil i Ternern, a roman azjies de borroch o ta mini ummior o aríen o baak, alla rummies mameil o choa sasalla, ṣoo poetautat inni ranied o Deos o gagil, maunis o ai chachimit o tapos, a barra, ṣoo adás, taulaulan, Amen. Ṣisi o karriatite.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Christian Maxims.
form: Atite o Atil o Christan.
standard: Atite o Atil o Christan.

label: item_01
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: God is essentially a Spirit. The soul in man is united with his body. God is incorporeal.
form: Ta Deos paga tsjes o auchos. Tsjes inni babos'aarpanni o bogsar. Marotul o bog ta Deos.
standard: Ta Deos paga tsjes o auchos. Tsjes inni babos'aarpanni o bogsar. Marotul o bog ta Deos.

label: item_02
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: The first forefathers of the human race were Adam and Eve. In the beginning God made man just and good. Haibos has tempted man to disobedience.
form: Boeboeno pesas'o tapos o babosa paga ta Adam a Eva. Ta Deos ani pesasa minerien o babosa mario a ma-ábisse. Ta haibos linummal'i kakossi o babosa.
standard: Boeboeno pesas'o tapos o babosa paga ta Adam a Eva. Ta Deos ani pesasa minerien o babosa mario a maábisse. Ta haibos linummal'i kakossi o babosa.

label: item_03
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In the beginning, Adam and Eve disobeyed God, so also have all their posterity. There is not one man who is righteous; all have sinned and have been born in sin. God is just, and punishes the wickedness of man.
form: Ta Adam a Eva ani pesasa kinummossi i ta Deos, ṣo-o tapos choa sjiem o sjiem. Allipa babosa mabissé tsjes: kinummossi ja patapos, ṣo-o ausjimen inni arapies. Ta Deos mabissé tsjes, ṣo-o pachalt o arapies o babosa.
standard: Ta Adam a Eva ani pesasa kinummossi i ta Deos, ṣoo tapos choa sjiem o sjiem. Allipa babosa mabissé tsjes: kinummossi ja patapos, ṣoo ausjimen inni arapies. Ta Deos mabissé tsjes, ṣoo pachalt o arapies o babosa.

label: item_04
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: On account of transgressions, God punishes all men with death. God is highly incensed at the disobedience of man. Christ is the Peacemaker, or Mediator between God and man.
form: Inau kakossi ta Deos pachalt o tapos o babos'o machá. Mauchus ja makabol inau kakossi o babosa ta Deos. Ta Christus paga ma-áborra tuppach o Deos a babosa.
standard: Inau kakossi ta Deos pachalt o tapos o babos'o machá. Mauchus ja makabol inau kakossi o babosa ta Deos. Ta Christus paga maáborra tuppach o Deos a babosa.

label: item_05
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Christ is the Son of God, and at the same time a Son of man. Christ is in one person: truly God and truly man. Christ, as man, is not born in iniquity or corruption.
form: Ta Christus paga sjiem o Deos, ṣo-o maibasṣar a rorró sjiem o babosa. Inni nattada boa paga Deos o gagil, ṣo-o gagil o babosa ta Christus. Ta Christus maibas o babosa alli inausjiem inni arapies.
standard: Ta Christus paga sjiem o Deos, ṣoo maibasṣar a rorró sjiem o babosa. Inni nattada boa paga Deos o gagil, ṣoo gagil o babosa ta Christus. Ta Christus maibas o babosa alli inausjiem inni arapies.

label: item_06
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Christ is a perfectly righteous man. The man Christ has suffered, and has died on account of man's disobedience. Christ has died for our sins, and has risen from the dead, so that we may live in Him.
form: Ta Christus paga babos'o auchos ma-abisse-bissé a tsjes. Ta Christus o babosa minachoté, ṣo-o minachá inau kakossi o babosa. Ta Christus minachá inau torroa kakossi, ṣo-o minaséas a machá, alla mamorich ja namo inni ichoṣar.
standard: Ta Christus paga babos'o auchos maabissebissé a tsjes. Ta Christus o babosa minachoté, ṣoo minachá inau kakossi o babosa. Ta Christus minachá inau torroa kakossi, ṣoo minaséas a machá, alla mamorich ja namo inni ichoṣar.

label: item_07
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: The death of Jesus Christ is the source of life eternal. God has punished man's disobedience in His own Son, Jesus Christ. The blood of Christ reconciles and satisfies God.
form: Innai machá o ta Christus tummoach o morich o ma-áchonṣar. Ta Deos pinachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa maunis a sjiem ta Jesus Christus. Ta Christus o choa taḡḡa pabórra ṣo-o tummaláttal'i ta Deos.
standard: Innai machá o ta Christus tummoach o morich o maáchonṣar. Ta Deos pinachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa maunis a sjiem ta Jesus Christus. Ta Christus o choa taḡḡa pabórra ṣoo tummaláttal'i ta Deos.

label: item_08
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: The blood of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, cleanseth us from all sin. Christ delivers His people from their sins. Christ is the Saviour of man.
form: Taḡḡ'o ta Christus Sjiem o Deos mitatsiel torro boa innai tapos arapies. Ta Christus parras o choa choṣar innai choa kakossi. Ta Christus paga ma-ababárras o babosa.
standard: Taḡḡ'o ta Christus Sjiem o Deos mitatsiel torro boa innai tapos arapies. Ta Christus parras o choa choṣar innai choa kakossi. Ta Christus paga maababárras o babosa.

label: item_09
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: On account of the suffering and death of His Son, God will have mercy upon all those who repent of their sins. Sorrow for our sins is acceptable to God. Faith in Jesus Christ is followed by the forgiveness of sins.
form: Inau machoté ṣo-o machá o choa Sjiem ta Deos mabóno tapos chono ai kamachi'o kakossi. Ta Deos maukat o zichil inau kakossi. Ábono kakossi kamarior o autat inni ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Inau machoté ṣoo machá o choa Sjiem ta Deos mabóno tapos chono ai kamachi'o kakossi. Ta Deos maukat o zichil inau kakossi. Ábono kakossi kamarior o autat inni ta Jesus Christus.

label: item_10
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Christ has ascended to heaven, so that He may continually intercede with His Father, and that His righteousness may hide our unrighteousness. True faith in Christ justifies all men, who are unrighteous. True faith cleanseth the heart from iniquity, and inclineth man to perform the works of righteousness.
form: Sinoss'i boesum ta Christus, alla tallochon papaz-inadóno choa choṣar katinnaam o choa tamau, ṣo-o tatummakkum torro'arapies o choa babissé. Autat o gagil inni ta Christus pabísse-bisse o tapos chono ai, allipa ja mabissé. Autat o gagil mitatsiel o tsjes innai arapies, ṣo-o maukat o tataap o babissé.
standard: Sinoss'i boesum ta Christus, alla tallochon papazinadóno choa choṣar katinnaam o choa tamau, ṣoo tatummakkum torro'arapies o choa babissé. Autat o gagil inni ta Christus pabíssebisse o tapos chono ai, allipa ja mabissé. Autat o gagil mitatsiel o tsjes innai arapies, ṣoo maukat o tataap o babissé.

label: item_11
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: True faith always accompanies the fear of God; the fear of God expels our wicked will and thoughts, and wards off sin. The peace of God, consolation, and gladness of heart continually accompany true faith and good works. True faith and prayer go hand in hand, like sister and brother.
form: Autat o ḡaḡil tallochon par'o ikkil o Deos, ikkil o Deos paube o rapies airab a tattuppa, ṣo-o miel o kakossi. Áborr'o ta Deos, tattalattala, ṣo-o aukat o tsjes tallochon par'o autat o gagil, so-o tataap o babisse. Autat o gagil ṣo-o ai-acha mababat a rorró maibas o atóasa.
standard: Autat o ḡaḡil tallochon par'o ikkil o Deos, ikkil o Deos paube o rapies airab a tattuppa, ṣoo miel o kakossi. Áborr'o ta Deos, tattalattala, ṣoo aukat o tsjes tallochon par'o autat o gagil, soo tataap o babisse. Autat o gagil ṣoo aiacha mababat a rorró maibas o atóasa.

label: item_12
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: The prayer of the believer obtaineth much. God grants the prayer and supplication of His people. All good gifts come from above, from the Father of Light.
form: Ai-ach'o ma-autat a cho kamauchus marach. Ta Deos maṣini o ai-acha ṣo-o annoḡḡonóḡḡono choa choṣar. Tapos ja áṣosono mario kaṣai innai de babó, innai de tamau o rará.
standard: Aiach'o maautat a cho kamauchus marach. Ta Deos maṣini o aiacha ṣoo annoḡḡonóḡḡono choa choṣar. Tapos ja áṣosono mario kaṣai innai de babó, innai de tamau o rará.

label: item_13
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Blessed is the people whose God is the Lord. God elects His chosen, whom He loves, out of all the generations of the earth, Christ is the head of all the children of God.
form: Kamario ija chono ai, kamaunis tamasea Deos paga ta Jehova. Ta Deos piri o choa aukattan a cho innai tapos o tupponodon de ta. Ta Christus paga oeno o tapos sisjiem o Deos.
standard: Kamario ija chono ai, kamaunis tamasea Deos paga ta Jehova. Ta Deos piri o choa aukattan a cho innai tapos o tupponodon de ta. Ta Christus paga oeno o tapos sisjiem o Deos.

label: item_14
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: All true believers are the children of God. There are many Christians, but few true believers. God knows only true believers, and gives them eternal life.
form: Tapos o gagil o ma-autat a cho paga sisjiem o Deos. Mapan Christan a cho, allipa ja mapan gagil o ma-autat a cho. Ta Deos makammichi mab'o gagil o ma-autat a cho, ṣo-o pe'i decho morich o ma-áchonṣar.
standard: Tapos o gagil o maautat a cho paga sisjiem o Deos. Mapan Christan a cho, allipa ja mapan gagil o maautat a cho. Ta Deos makammichi mab'o gagil o maautat a cho, ṣoo pe'i decho morich o maáchonṣar.

label: item_15
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Eternal life is in the Son of God, Jesus Christ. This eternal life consists in the beholding of God in heaven, in peace, rest, and everlasting joy, without end. Christ is the Resurrection from the dead, and the Life; he that believeth in Him shall live though he were dead.,
form: Morich o ma-áchonṣar o paga inni ta sjiem o Deos ta Jesus Christus. Morich ma-áchonṣar o mini paga o ai-all'o ta Deos i boesum, áborra, árra, ṣo-o aukat o taulaulan pa ṣisi-ech. Ta Christus paga aṣéas o machá, ṣo-o morich o ai, tamasea poetautat inni ichoṣar, mamorich, pagatomma kamach'ija icho.
standard: Morich o maáchonṣar o paga inni ta sjiem o Deos ta Jesus Christus. Morich maáchonṣar o mini paga o aiall'o ta Deos i boesum, áborra, árra, ṣoo aukat o taulaulan pa ṣisiech. Ta Christus paga aṣéas o machá, ṣoo morich o ai, tamasea poetautat inni ichoṣar, mamorich, pagatomma kamach'ija icho.

label: item_16
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: As Christ died and rose again from the dead, so they also who die in Christ shall be raised from the dead. At the end of all things, the day of judgment will come. In the final day of judgment Christ will recompense every one according to his works.
form: Maibas o ta Christus minachá, ṣo-o minaṣéas a machá, masini channumma tamasea kamach'ija inni ta Christus, allecho ipáṣeas a machá. Ka ṣisi o mini tapos ai tatummoach o zijsja d'o chachalt o tapos o cho. Ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho ta Christus pape o atatta choṣar kamaibas o choa tataap.
standard: Maibas o ta Christus minachá, ṣoo minaṣéas a machá, masini channumma tamasea kamach'ija inni ta Christus, allecho ipáṣeas a machá. Ka ṣisi o mini tapos ai tatummoach o zijsja d'o chachalt o tapos o cho. Ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho ta Christus pape o atatta choṣar kamaibas o choa tataap.

label: item_17
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Recompense will follow after this life: either the joy of heaven or the punishment of hell-fire. Woe unto all drunkards. Woe unto all idolaters, who sacrifice to haibos.
form: Á-ri-jor a morich o mini ummior o chachad; ja aukat i boesum, ja chachalt o chau i Gehenna. Anana i tapos chono ma-árab. Anana i tapos aran o Deos o baak, ṣo-o tamasea paan o haibos.
standard: Árijor a morich o mini ummior o chachad; ja aukat i boesum, ja chachalt o chau i Gehenna. Anana i tapos chono maárab. Anana i tapos aran o Deos o baak, ṣoo tamasea paan o haibos.

label: item_18
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Woe unto those who die in their sins, for their part shall be the lake of fire. Blessed are the dead who have repented of their sins, and who die in Christ; they rest, and their works do follow them. The body dies, the soul remains alive.
form: Anana i macháda ai, tamasea kamach'ija inni choa kakossi, inau choa áda paga inni chauch o chau. Ka mario ija machada ai, tamasea machi'o kakossi, ṣo-o kamach'ija inni ta Christus; pissassen ja, ṣo-o choa tataap ummior i decho. Ka mach'ija bog, máchonṣar morich ja tsjes.
standard: Anana i macháda ai, tamasea kamach'ija inni choa kakossi, inau choa áda paga inni chauch o chau. Ka mario ija machada ai, tamasea machi'o kakossi, ṣoo kamach'ija inni ta Christus; pissassen ja, ṣoo choa tataap ummior i decho. Ka mach'ija bog, máchonṣar morich ja tsjes.

label: item_19
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: The body is perishable, the soul is imperishable. The body decays in the grave, the soul of the believer goes to heaven.
form: Ka moribal ja bog, pa moribal ja tsjes. Ka mabocho ja bog i robaan, maboas ja tsjes o ma-autat acho i boesum ai.
standard: Ka moribal ja bog, pa moribal ja tsjes. Ka mabocho ja bog i robaan, maboas ja tsjes o maautat acho i boesum ai.

label: item_20
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In the day of general judgment the dead bodies shall be again united to their souls and live again; thereupon they who ordinarily have followed after righteousness shall go to heaven, but they who have constantly done iniquity shall enter into hell-fire.
form: Ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho bog o machád'allecho aarpanni o tattaul'o choa tsjes, ṣo-o ipaurichṣar: kasagh-á tamasea inummior tallochon o babissé, ṣaṣoss'i boesum; kasjabaan tamasea tallochon pinarapies, ṣaṣoss'i chau o Gehenna. Ṣisi o atite o atil o Christan.
standard: Ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho bog o machád'allecho aarpanni o tattaul'o choa tsjes, ṣoo ipaurichṣar: kasaghá tamasea inummior tallochon o babissé, ṣaṣoss'i boesum; kasjabaan tamasea tallochon pinarapies, ṣaṣoss'i chau o Gehenna. Ṣisi o atite o atil o Christan.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord.
form: Chachod o Ai-Ach'o Christan.
standard: Chachod o AiAch'o Christan.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_01_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Whom do you call the Father in heaven?
form: Tomm'ijo pattonan o tamau de boesum?
standard: Tomm'ijo pattonan o tamau de boesum?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_01_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: God.
form: Ta Deos.
standard: Ta Deos.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_02_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Why is He called our Father?
form: Inaunumma attonannan ja icho namoa tamau?
standard: Inaunumma attonannan ja icho namoa tamau?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_02_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Because it is He who has made our bodies and souls, and He also who supports us.
form: Inau icho mineriensar torroa bog a tsjes-oë, ṣo-o porích torro boa channumma.
standard: Inau icho mineriensar torroa bog a tsjesoë, ṣoo porích torro boa channumma.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_03_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Why is He called a Father in heaven?
form: Inaunumma attonannan ja icho tamau de boesum?
standard: Inaunumma attonannan ja icho tamau de boesum?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_03_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Because He is not like our fathers on earth.
form: Inau alli maibas o tamauno de ta ja icho.
standard: Inau alli maibas o tamauno de ta ja icho.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_04_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: What do these words teach us: Our Father, which art in heaven?
form: Numm'attillán ja namo innai atite o miniṣar, namoa tamau tamasea paga de boesum?
standard: Numm'attillán ja namo innai atite o miniṣar, namoa tamau tamasea paga de boesum?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_04_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: They teach us that, when we pray, we should put away from us the pride of the heart, and that we should fear God, who lives so high above us, above the clouds.
form: Alla namo, ṣabanno mai meacha, maspot a tummis o aṣies o tsjes, ṣo-o mikkil o Deos, tamasea pattodon mauchus a ró de babó rabbó.
standard: Alla namo, ṣabanno mai meacha, maspot a tummis o aṣies o tsjes, ṣoo mikkil o Deos, tamasea pattodon mauchus a ró de babó rabbó.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_05_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Who has taught us this prayer?
form: Todacho ja pináttil torro ai-ach'o miniṣar?
standard: Todacho ja pináttil torro aiach'o miniṣar?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_05_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: The Son of God, our Lord Jesus Christ.
form: Sjiem badd'o Deos, torroa ma-acháchimit ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Sjiem badd'o Deos, torroa maacháchimit ta Jesus Christus.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_06_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: How many things do we desire God to give us?
form: Naida tuppo torro meach'o Deos-ṣar.
standard: Naida tuppo torro meach'o Deosṣar.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_06_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: These six:- 1. That we may praise His great name. 2. That He may reign over us, and make us righteous, as He is righteous. 3. That we may follow His commandments as a righteous people. 4. That He may provide us with bodily sustenance, and support us as a father does his children. 5. That God in His mercy may forgive us when we commit evil, and not punish us. 6. That God may protect us from haibos, our enemy and envier.
form: Nataap o miniṣar:- Kapesasa, alla torro madas o choa naan mauchus mato. Ka narroa, alla mariona icho chummimit torro boa, ṣo-o merien torro ma-abisse-abissé tsjes maibas icho. Ka natorroa, alla torro maibas o ma-abissé tsjes chonoë ummior o cho'atillo. Ka naspat, all'icho pe'i torro inochan, ṣo-o paan torro boa maibas o tamau choa sisjiem. Ka nachap, alla Deos mabono torro boa, sabanno torro rummapies, ṣo-o alli túmmea. Ka nataap, alla Deos maladik o torroa boa innai ta haibos-ech, torro'ázjies-in ṣo-o ma-asannan.
standard: Nataap o miniṣar:- Kapesasa, alla torro madas o choa naan mauchus mato. Ka narroa, alla mariona icho chummimit torro boa, ṣoo merien torro maabisseabissé tsjes maibas icho. Ka natorroa, alla torro maibas o maabissé tsjes chonoë ummior o cho'atillo. Ka naspat, all'icho pe'i torro inochan, ṣoo paan torro boa maibas o tamau choa sisjiem. Ka nachap, alla Deos mabono torro boa, sabanno torro rummapies, ṣoo alli túmmea. Ka nataap, alla Deos maladik o torroa boa innai ta haibosech, torro'ázjiesin ṣoo maasannan.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_07_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Why?
form: Inaunumma?
standard: Inaunumma?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_07_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Because we also forgive others, when they do evil to us.
form: Inau channumma namo mabono roman a cho ṣabanno parapies i namo dechonoë.
standard: Inau channumma namo mabono roman a cho ṣabanno parapies i namo dechonoë.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_08_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: How then?
form: Moedaṣar?
standard: Moedaṣar?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_08_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: That He may forbid haibos, and not permit him to poison us, that is, tempt us to evil.
form: Alla maddik i ta haibos, ṣo-o alli pauss'i icho sumbach i namo, michoṣar a pattite, lummal'i arapies.
standard: Alla maddik i ta haibos, ṣoo alli pauss'i icho sumbach i namo, michoṣar a pattite, lummal'i arapies.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_09_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Why is haibos called the evil-one?
form: Inaunumma attonannan ta haibos rapies ai?
standard: Inaunumma attonannan ta haibos rapies ai?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_09_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Because he is indeed very malignant and very disobedient to God's word.
form: Inau gagil icho rapies tsjes, ṣo-o mauchus kummossi o attite o Deos.
standard: Inau gagil icho rapies tsjes, ṣoo mauchus kummossi o attite o Deos.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_10_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: What is the signification of Amen?
form: Numma micho a pattite, Amen?
standard: Numma micho a pattite, Amen?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_10_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Amen signifies that it is certain, and that God will do as we wish.
form: Amen, micho a pattite gagilna, ṣo-o allecho merien ta Deos maibas ja torro meácha.
standard: Amen, micho a pattite gagilna, ṣoo allecho merien ta Deos maibas ja torro meácha.

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_11_question
notes: Question turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Whence do you know that?
form: Innaidem'ijo maba dai?
standard: Innaidem'ijo maba dai?

section_title: Questions on the Prayer of the Lord
label: qa_11_answer
notes: Answer turn split at printed Q/A labels; labels omitted
translation: Because He alone has the dominion and the power, be it in heaven, be it on earth, and all this in order that we should praise His Name.
form: Inau ma-akammichiṣar icho paga chachimit o tapos a barra, pagatomma de boesum, pagatomma de ta, ṣo-o mini tapos ai, alla torro mamadás o choa naan.
standard: Inau maakammichiṣar icho paga chachimit o tapos a barra, pagatomma de boesum, pagatomma de ta, ṣoo mini tapos ai, alla torro mamadás o choa naan.

label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: Questions on the Christian Belief.
form: Chachod o Autat o Christan.
standard: Chachod o Autat o Christan.

label: item_01
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the Christian belief? The Christian belief is a sure knowledge of God, and of the testimony of His Word, whereby I am fully assured - causing my heart to be filled with consolation - that God the Father is my God and Father for the sake of His Son Jesus Christ, who will mercifully forgive me all my sins, give me on this earth sustenance, and hereafter life everlasting in heaven.
form: Numm'ija autat o Christan? Autat o Christan paga gagil o ab'o Deos, ṣo-o o al'o choa ranied, innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, ṣo-o tummoach i na-a tsjes tattalattal'o mini, alla Deos o tamau inau choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus paga na-a micho Deos a tamau, tamasea merab o mabóno tapos na-a kakossi, pe'o inochan ina de ta mini, ṣo-o sagha-a rummi-es morich o ma-áchonṣar i boesum ai.
standard: Numm'ija autat o Christan? Autat o Christan paga gagil o ab'o Deos, ṣoo o al'o choa ranied, innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, ṣoo tummoach i naa tsjes tattalattal'o mini, alla Deos o tamau inau choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus paga naa micho Deos a tamau, tamasea merab o mabóno tapos naa kakossi, pe'o inochan ina de ta mini, ṣoo saghaa rummies morich o maáchonṣar i boesum ai.

label: item_02
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What do you call God? I call God essentially a Spirit, and a Being, or Person who is self-created, and who will always exist.
form: Pattonan onumm'ijo ta Deos? Na-a pattonan o ta Deos tsjes o auchos, ṣo-o nattada ga ja boa, tamasea maunis pinaga, ṣo-o paga taulaulan.
standard: Pattonan onumm'ijo ta Deos? Naa pattonan o ta Deos tsjes o auchos, ṣoo nattada ga ja boa, tamasea maunis pinaga, ṣoo paga taulaulan.

label: item_03
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How many gods are there? There is one God in three persons- the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.
form: Naida Deos paga ja? Paga nattaṣar a Deos inni natorroa-da boa, o Tamau, ta Sjiem, ṣo-o ta auchar o Deos o ma-áchimit ta Spirito Santo.
standard: Naida Deos paga ja? Paga nattaṣar a Deos inni natorroada boa, o Tamau, ta Sjiem, ṣoo ta auchar o Deos o maáchimit ta Spirito Santo.

label: item_04
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does that mean - I believe in God the Father? That signifies - I am quite convinced and firmly persuaded in my heart that, according to the testimony of God's Word, God the Father has, from all eternity, begotten His Son, the true image and likeness of His person, and that He is truly God, even as He is.
form: Numma micho a pattite, na-a poetautat inni Deos o Tamau? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣo-o poetat o na-a tsjes, alla Deos o tamau ani taulaulan pinausjiem o; choa sjiem, gagil a isas ṣo-o tatṣar o choa micho boa, ṣo-o Deos o gagil maibas icho.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, naa poetautat inni Deos o Tamau? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣoo poetat o naa tsjes, alla Deos o tamau ani taulaulan pinausjiem o; choa sjiem, gagil a isas ṣoo tatṣar o choa micho boa, ṣoo Deos o gagil maibas icho.

label: item_05
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does God beget or generate as men do? No; He generates in quite a different way. Let me mention some comparisons: such as, the soul spontaneously generates the understanding, will, and thoughts, as a fountain pours out its waters of its own accord. Thus, our understanding, will, and thoughts proceed from the soul and abide in the same; in like manner, the Son of God proceeds from the Father and abides in Him. As a fountain does not cease to let its waters flow, even so the Father does not cease to beget His Son.
form: Ja ta Deos pausjiem maibas o babosa? Pa: maunionis ja choa pausjiem. Alla na-a pe'o charri o tatschier; maibas o tsjes patoach o saan, o airab a tattuppa, maibas o chuppod pachuppod o to. Maibas o ṣaan, airab, a tattuppa, ṣai innaide tsjes, ṣo-o machonṣar inni tsjes, masini sjiem o Deos ṣai innai o tamau, ṣo-o machonṣar inni ichoṣar. Maibas o chuppod alli pittol o pachuppod o to, masini o tamau alli poṣisi o pausjiem o choa sjiem.
standard: Ja ta Deos pausjiem maibas o babosa? Pa: maunionis ja choa pausjiem. Alla naa pe'o charri o tatschier; maibas o tsjes patoach o saan, o airab a tattuppa, maibas o chuppod pachuppod o to. Maibas o ṣaan, airab, a tattuppa, ṣai innaide tsjes, ṣoo machonṣar inni tsjes, masini sjiem o Deos ṣai innai o tamau, ṣoo machonṣar inni ichoṣar. Maibas o chuppod alli pittol o pachuppod o to, masini o tamau alli poṣisi o pausjiem o choa sjiem.

label: item_06
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why do you add these words - Creator of heaven and earth? Because by the Word of God I am quite convinced and fully persuaded in my heart that God the Father has, from the very beginning, made heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that therein is, that He upholdeth all these things by His power, and that He rules over them by His wisdom.
form: Inaunumm'ijo pachip o atite o mini, Airien o boesum a ta? Inau kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣo-o poetat o na-a tsjes, alla Deos o tamau ani pesasa minerien o boesum, o ta, a abas, ṣo-o tapos o ai lallum choa baan, tamasea tumk'o mini tapos ai; o choa barra, ṣo-o chummimit o choa aba.
standard: Inaunumm'ijo pachip o atite o mini, Airien o boesum a ta? Inau kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣoo poetat o naa tsjes, alla Deos o tamau ani pesasa minerien o boesum, o ta, a abas, ṣoo tapos o ai lallum choa baan, tamasea tumk'o mini tapos ai; o choa barra, ṣoo chummimit o choa aba.

label: item_07
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the meaning of Almighty? These words signify that God the Father performs everything according to His will, and that He shows His great power in the creation of heaven, of the earth, and the sea; that His power never tires, and that His will and His word are not restricted by any other being.
form: Numma micho a pattite, kamabara'ija tapos o ai? Atite o mini pab'ija alla Deos o tamau ummoob o tapos choa airab, ṣo-o pait'o choa barra mato inni tataap o boesum, o ta, a abas tamase'alli mab'o orachan, ṣo-o choa airab alli ilen innai-de romanech.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, kamabara'ija tapos o ai? Atite o mini pab'ija alla Deos o tamau ummoob o tapos choa airab, ṣoo pait'o choa barra mato inni tataap o boesum, o ta, a abas tamase'alli mab'o orachan, ṣoo choa airab alli ilen innai de romanech.

label: item_08
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does faith in God the Father Almighty give to your heart? It gives me the full conviction - even as my mind also bears witness thereto- that God the Father is my God and Father for the sake of His Son Jesus Christ; that God loves me as His child, and guards me from all evil.
form: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innau autat inni Deos o tamau, kamabarr'ija tapos o ai? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, maibas o na-a tsjes channumma maunis-o-ala, alla Deos o tamau inau choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus paga na-a micho Deos a tamau, tamasea maukat ina maibas o choa sjiem, ṣo-o maladik o na-a boa innai patapos rapies.
standard: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innau autat inni Deos o tamau, kamabarr'ija tapos o ai? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, maibas o naa tsjes channumma maunis o ala, alla Deos o tamau inau choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus paga naa micho Deos a tamau, tamasea maukat ina maibas o choa sjiem, ṣoo maladik o naa boa innai patapos rapies.

label: item_09
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who is the second Person in God's nature? The Son of God, Jesus Christ.
form: Tomm'ija kanarroa-da boa inni ga o Deos-ṣar? Sjiem o Deos ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Tomm'ija kanarroada boa inni ga o Deosṣar? Sjiem o Deos ta Jesus Christus.

label: item_10
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you believe in the Son of God? Yes; I believe at the same time in God the Father, and in His Son, just as the Son of God commands, saying, Ye believe in God, believe also in Me.
form: Ja poetautat ijonoë inni ta sjiem o Deos channumma? Hena, maibasṣar a rorró na-a poetautat inni Deos o tamau, ṣo-o inni choa sjiem: maibas ja pattillo ta sjiem o Deos; imoa poetautat inni ta Deos, oetautatta inni na-ada boa channumma, machó.
standard: Ja poetautat ijonoë inni ta sjiem o Deos channumma? Hena, maibasṣar a rorró naa poetautat inni Deos o tamau, ṣoo inni choa sjiem: maibas ja pattillo ta sjiem o Deos; imoa poetautat inni ta Deos, oetautatta inni naada boa channumma, machó.

label: item_11
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does this signify - I believe in the only-begotten Son of God? That I am fully convinced, according to the testimony of God's Word, and in my mind hold fast thereunto, that the second Person, Jesus Christ, is God's own Son, very God of God.
form: Numma micho a pattite, na-a poetautat inni sjiem o Deos nattaṣar o binodda? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣo-o poetat o na-a tsjes, alla kanarroa-da boa ta Jesus Christus paga maunis a sjiem o Deos, gagil o Deos innai Deos-ṣar.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, naa poetautat inni sjiem o Deos nattaṣar o binodda? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣoo poetat o naa tsjes, alla kanarroada boa ta Jesus Christus paga maunis a sjiem o Deos, gagil o Deos innai Deosṣar.

label: item_12
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the name of the Son of God? His name, like that of His Father, is Jehovah, because He is truly God.
form: Naan onumma paga ta sjiem o Deos? Choa naan, maibas o choa tamau, paga ta Jehova, inau paga gagil o Deos icho.
standard: Naan onumma paga ta sjiem o Deos? Choa naan, maibas o choa tamau, paga ta Jehova, inau paga gagil o Deos icho.

label: item_13
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does that name of Jesus signify? Jesus signifies a redeemer of men.
form: Naan onumma micho ta Jesus? Ta Jesus micho a pattite maababárras o babosa.
standard: Naan onumma micho ta Jesus? Ta Jesus micho a pattite maababárras o babosa.

label: item_14
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does the Son of God bear this name? Yes, with regard to His human nature.
form: Ja ta sjiem o Deos marach o naan o mini? Hena, maibas paga babosa ja icho.
standard: Ja ta sjiem o Deos marach o naan o mini? Hena, maibas paga babosa ja icho.

label: item_15
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How, then, is the Son of God also a man? Yes; He is the Son of God, and at the same time like unto a son of man.
form: Mai numma, ja ta sjiem o Deos paga babosa channumma? Hena: paga sjiem o Deos, ṣo-o maibasṣar a rorró sjiem o babosa.
standard: Mai numma, ja ta sjiem o Deos paga babosa channumma? Hena: paga sjiem o Deos, ṣoo maibasṣar a rorró sjiem o babosa.

label: item_16
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Are there two persons in Him, the person of a man, and the Person of God? No; there dwell in Him two beings or natures and one person. As in man the soul is united to the body in one person, so also the nature of man is united with the divine nature into one person in Christ Jesus.
form: Ja paga narroa-da boa inni ichoṣar, bo'o babosa, ṣo-o bo'o Deos-ṣar? Pa: narroa ja ḡa paga inni icho, ṣo-o nattada boa. Maibas o tsjes aarpanni o bogṣar inni babosa pana nattada boa, masini ḡa o babosa aarpanni o ḡa o Deosṣar pana nattada boa inni ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Ja paga narroada boa inni ichoṣar, bo'o babosa, ṣoo bo'o Deosṣar? Pa: narroa ja ḡa paga inni icho, ṣoo nattada boa. Maibas o tsjes aarpanni o bogṣar inni babosa pana nattada boa, masini ḡa o babosa aarpanni o ḡa o Deosṣar pana nattada boa inni ta Jesus Christus.

label: item_17
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has the Son of God been always human? No; for the transgression of man He appeared in this world in the nature of man, so that He might suffer for man's disobedience.
form: Ja ta sjiem o Deos taulaulan pinaga babosa? Pa: inau kakossi o babosa tsinummoach i ta mini inni ḡa o babosa, alla lalummaslas o torroa kakossi.
standard: Ja ta sjiem o Deos taulaulan pinaga babosa? Pa: inau kakossi o babosa tsinummoach i ta mini inni ḡa o babosa, alla lalummaslas o torroa kakossi.

label: item_18
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why did the Son of God appear in the form of man? That God might execute His judgment, and punish (our) transgressions m His bon, appearing in the form of man, who had transgressed against God.
form: Inonumma ta sjiem o Deos tsinummoach inni ḡa o babosa? Alla ta Deos a-ummior o choa babissé, ṣo-o pachalt o kakossi inni choa sjiem, inni ḡa o babosa, o ai kinummossi i ta Deos.
standard: Inonumma ta sjiem o Deos tsinummoach inni ḡa o babosa? Alla ta Deos aummior o choa babissé, ṣoo pachalt o kakossi inni choa sjiem, inni ḡa o babosa, o ai kinummossi i ta Deos.

label: item_19
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why has God punished the transgressions of men in His own Son? In order that He might show His love to man, and deliver him from the punishment of sin.
form: Inonumma ta Deos pinachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa maunis a sjiem? Alla papait'o choa aukat pana babosa, ṣo-o parras i decho innai chachalt o kakossi.
standard: Inonumma ta Deos pinachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa maunis a sjiem? Alla papait'o choa aukat pana babosa, ṣoo parras i decho innai chachalt o kakossi.

label: item_20
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Is it righteous that God should punish the transgressions of man in His own Son? Yes, it is, because the Son of God is the Mediator between God and man, who by His death reconciles and satisfies God, His Father; so that all who are repentant of their sins and believe in Him may obtain the forgiveness of sins and life everlasting in His name.
form: Ja mabisse micho, alla ta Deos pachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa sjiem? Hena: inau ta sjiem o Deos paga ma-áborro tuppach o Deos a babosa, tamase'o choa machá pabbórra ṣo-o tummalattal'i ta Deos choa tamau, alla tapos chono ai kamachi'o kakossi, ṣo-o poetautat inni choa boa, mamarach o ábono kakossi, ṣo-o morich o ma-áchonṣar inni choa naan.
standard: Ja mabisse micho, alla ta Deos pachalt o kakossi o babosa inni choa sjiem? Hena: inau ta sjiem o Deos paga maáborro tuppach o Deos a babosa, tamase'o choa machá pabbórra ṣoo tummalattal'i ta Deos choa tamau, alla tapos chono ai kamachi'o kakossi, ṣoo poetautat inni choa boa, mamarach o ábono kakossi, ṣoo morich o maáchonṣar inni choa naan.

label: item_21
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is Christ? This name denotes that God the Father has given His Son the power to deliver man.
form: Numm'ija ta Christus? Naan o mini ta Christus paita alla Deos o tamau pinaatsikap o choa sjiem, alla paparras o babosa.
standard: Numm'ija ta Christus? Naan o mini ta Christus paita alla Deos o tamau pinaatsikap o choa sjiem, alla paparras o babosa.

label: item_22
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why do you call the Son of God our Lord? Because He has purchased a peculiar people with His blood.
form: Inaunumma pattonan ijonoë o sjiem o Deos ma-acháchimit ja torro? Inau o choa taḡḡa pinattodoch o cho maunis icho.
standard: Inaunumma pattonan ijonoë o sjiem o Deos maacháchimit ja torro? Inau o choa taḡḡa pinattodoch o cho maunis icho.

label: item_23
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who is this peculiar people? All we who believe in Him and listen to His voice.
form: Tomm'ija maunis a chono micho? Torro patapos tamasea poetautat inni choa boa, ṣo-o ummior o choa charṣar.
standard: Tomm'ija maunis a chono micho? Torro patapos tamasea poetautat inni choa boa, ṣoo ummior o choa charṣar.

label: item_24
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Are we His servants and His peculiar people? Yes; our bodies and our souls belong to Him. Formerly we were the servants of haibos, and followed after him in his disobedience, so that we were made subservient to his will; the Son of God has delivered us from haibos' power and dominion, in order that we should, as servants, domestics, and as His peculiar people, follow His word and command.
form: Ja torro paga choa aran, so-o maunis a cho? Hena: torroa bog, torroa tsjes maunis icho. Ani torro paga aran o haibos, ṣo-o tsimichier o choa kakossi, tamasea pinauloan torro boa pana de rapo choa airab. Ta sjiem o Deos pinarras o torroa boa innai barra ṣo-o chachimit o haibos, alla torro maibas o choa aran, chodon, ṣo-o maunis a cho aummior o cho'atite ṣo-o átillo.
standard: Ja torro paga choa aran, soo maunis a cho? Hena: torroa bog, torroa tsjes maunis icho. Ani torro paga aran o haibos, ṣoo tsimichier o choa kakossi, tamasea pinauloan torro boa pana de rapo choa airab. Ta sjiem o Deos pinarras o torroa boa innai barra ṣoo chachimit o haibos, alla torro maibas o choa aran, chodon, ṣoo maunis a cho aummior o cho'atite ṣoo átillo.

label: item_25
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does faith in the Son of God, the Lord Jesus Christ, give unto your heart? Thereby I am fully convinced that the Son of God has loved me, that He has appeared in human nature, in order that He might deliver me from the punishment of sin, and that He will protect me from the dominion and violence of haibos, inasmuch as I am His servant and belong to Him.
form: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat inni ta sjiem o Deos, ma-acháchimit o ai ta Jesus Christus? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina alla ta sjiem o Deos minaukat o ina tsinummoach i ḡa o babosa, alla paparras o na-a boa innai chachalt o kakossi, ṣo-o mamaladik innai chachimit a barr'o haibos, inau paga ja ina choa aran, ṣo-o maunis icho.
standard: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat inni ta sjiem o Deos, maacháchimit o ai ta Jesus Christus? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina alla ta sjiem o Deos minaukat o ina tsinummoach i ḡa o babosa, alla paparras o naa boa innai chachalt o kakossi, ṣoo mamaladik innai chachimit a barr'o haibos, inau paga ja ina choa aran, ṣoo maunis icho.

label: item_26
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has Christ been conceived in His mother's body, as all other persons? No; He has been conceived or begotten by the Breath of God, the Holy Spirit.
form: Ja ta Christus inararain inni tsjes o choa tanai maibas o tapos roman a babosa? Maini: maunionis karinab icho innaide Auchar o Deos o maachimit, ta Spirito Santo.
standard: Ja ta Christus inararain inni tsjes o choa tanai maibas o tapos roman a babosa? Maini: maunionis karinab icho innaide Auchar o Deos o maachimit, ta Spirito Santo.

label: item_27
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has He no Father? No, not as Son of man; as the Son of God He has a Father.
form: Ja alpa tamau icho? Pa, maibas o sjiem o babosa, maibas o sjiem o Deos paga tamau.
standard: Ja alpa tamau icho? Pa, maibas o sjiem o babosa, maibas o sjiem o Deos paga tamau.

label: item_28
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has He a mother? Yes, as a Son of man; as the Son of God He has no mother.
form: Ja paga tanai? Paga maibas o sjiem o babosa; maibas o sjiem o Deos, pa ja tanai.
standard: Ja paga tanai? Paga maibas o sjiem o babosa; maibas o sjiem o Deos, pa ja tanai.

label: item_29
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who is His mother? The betrothed Virgin Mary.
form: Tomm'ija choa tanai? Patomámmali ta Maria.
standard: Tomm'ija choa tanai? Patomámmali ta Maria.

label: item_30
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Was His mother a betrothed and true virgin? Yes; Mary being a true virgin brought forth her Son Jesus Christ; being yet betrothed to her husband Joseph, she became pregnant, although she had not known any man.
form: Ja paga patomámmali, ṣo-o mammali o gagil choa tanai? Hena: ta Maria pinodd'o choa sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus mammali o gagil; acho par'o choa róòs ta Joseph; karinummab, acho pinar'o sjam.
standard: Ja paga patomámmali, ṣoo mammali o gagil choa tanai? Hena: ta Maria pinodd'o choa sjiem badda ta Jesus Christus mammali o gagil; acho par'o choa róòs ta Joseph; karinummab, acho pinar'o sjam.

label: item_31
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did she, then, conceive of herself? No; the Breath of God the Holy Ghost did, by His hidden power, make Mary, the betrothed virgin, pregnant with child.
form: Oedan, ja maunis o rinummab? Maini: ta Auchar o Deos Spirito Santo pinararain o patomámmali Maria o choa barr'o maacharrieb.
standard: Oedan, ja maunis o rinummab? Maini: ta Auchar o Deos Spirito Santo pinararain o patomámmali Maria o choa barr'o maacharrieb.

label: item_32
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why is Christ conceived and generated by the Holy Ghost? That human nature might be made perfectly righteous in Him, and not be generated in iniquity, as all other men.
form: Inonumma karinab ṣo-o inausjiem ta Christus innaide Auchar o ma-achimit, ta Spirito Santo? Alla ḡa o babos'inni ichoṣar papaga o auchos ma-abisse a tsjes, ṣo-o alii ausjimen inni arapies, maibas o tapos roman babosa.
standard: Inonumma karinab ṣoo inausjiem ta Christus innaide Auchar o maachimit, ta Spirito Santo? Alla ḡa o babos'inni ichoṣar papaga o auchos maabisse a tsjes, ṣoo alii ausjimen inni arapies, maibas o tapos roman babosa.

label: item_33
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Was that proper? Yes; it was proper that the Mediator of man should be righteous, and innocent of evil.
form: Ja makkesjap o micho? Hena: makkesjap o ma-áborr'o babosa, alla mabisse-bissé tsjes, ṣo-o alli mab'o arapies.
standard: Ja makkesjap o micho? Hena: makkesjap o maáborr'o babosa, alla mabissebissé tsjes, ṣoo alli mab'o arapies.

label: item_34
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what country was Christ born? In the country of the Jews, in the village of Bethlehem.
form: Inni ta onumma binodda ta Christus? Inni ta o chono i Judaea lallum assaban Bethlehem.
standard: Inni ta onumma binodda ta Christus? Inni ta o chono i Judaea lallum assaban Bethlehem.

label: item_35
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: When? About sixteen hundred and fifty years ago.
form: Aninumma? Ani manna-achpil a tschiet eis, mannatorro-us a tschiet eis, ṣo-o narroa eis tschiet a baas.
standard: Aninumma? Ani mannaachpil a tschiet eis, mannatorrous a tschiet eis, ṣoo narroa eis tschiet a baas.

label: item_36
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: To what nation did His mother belong?. (She was) a Jewish virgin, remotely descended from David, the King of the Jews.
form: Azjies onumma pinaga choa tanai? Mammali o chono i Judaea, kabossot ani o mario-a-cho o chono i Judaea ta David.
standard: Azjies onumma pinaga choa tanai? Mammali o chono i Judaea, kabossot ani o mario a cho o chono i Judaea ta David.

label: item_37
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does faith in Jesus Christ, the Son of Mary, the Son of man, begotten and generated by the Holy Ghost, give to your heart?
