It assures me that Christ is my flesh and blood, that He is my eldest Brother and Kinsman, who, in His human nature, is my righteous Mediator, so that He hides my iniquity and transgressions from God by His righteousness.
form: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat inni ta Jesus Christus sjiem o Maria, sjiem o babosa, karinab ṣo-o mausjiem innaide Spirito Santo? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus paga na-a boa ṣo-o taḡḡa, na-a machen ṣo-o ma-acháddik o cho, tamasea inni ḡa o babosa paga ma-áborra ina maabisse-bissé tsjes, all'o choa babissé tummakkoob o na-a arapies ṣo-o kakossi katinnaam o Deos.
standard: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat inni ta Jesus Christus sjiem o Maria, sjiem o babosa, karinab ṣoo mausjiem innaide Spirito Santo? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus paga naa boa ṣoo taḡḡa, naa machen ṣoo maacháddik o cho, tamasea inni ḡa o babosa paga maáborra ina maabissebissé tsjes, all'o choa babissé tummakkoob o naa arapies ṣoo kakossi katinnaam o Deos.

label: item_38
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does the righteousness of Christ make you righteous before God? Yes; His righteousness and good works are my own, and are considered as my righteousness before God.
form: Ja ta Christus pabísse-bisse oa boa katinnaam o Deos o choa babissé? Hena: choa babissé, ṣo-o mario a tataap paga maunis ja ina, ṣo-o katochen maibas o na-a micho babissé katinnaam o Deos.
standard: Ja ta Christus pabíssebisse oa boa katinnaam o Deos o choa babissé? Hena: choa babissé, ṣoo mario a tataap paga maunis ja ina, ṣoo katochen maibas o naa micho babissé katinnaam o Deos.

label: item_39
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How does that happen? All they who truly believe in Christ are incorporated into Him, and participate in His righteousness and good works.
form: Moed'ija micho? Tapos chono ai kapoetautat o gagil inni ta Jesus Christus, inaarpan o choa boá, ṣo-o paga rorrónoad'inni choa babissé a mario a tataap.
standard: Moed'ija micho? Tapos chono ai kapoetautat o gagil inni ta Jesus Christus, inaarpan o choa boá, ṣoo paga rorrónoad'inni choa babissé a mario a tataap.

label: item_40
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why? Christ imparts unto them His righteousness and true faith; and, as a hand, accepts of its own accord His righteousness and benefits.
form: Inaunumma? Ta Christus passoso i decho choa babissé, ṣo-o autat o gagil maibas o rima tummaap a mauniso-arach o choa babissé, a mario-a tataap.
standard: Inaunumma? Ta Christus passoso i decho choa babissé, ṣoo autat o gagil maibas o rima tummaap a mauniso arach o choa babissé, a mario a tataap.

label: item_41
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Where has Christ suffered, and where did He die? In the land of the Jews, near the city of Jerusalem.
form: Dema minachoté ṣo-o minachá ta Christus? De ta i Judaea, chaddik o assaban mato Jerusalem.
standard: Dema minachoté ṣoo minachá ta Christus? De ta i Judaea, chaddik o assaban mato Jerusalem.

label: item_42
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who governed the land of the Jews then? Pontius Pilate, a Roman stranger, was protector and judge in Jerusalem.
form: Todacho baas ai merien o assaban o chono i-Judaea? Ta Ta Pontius Pilatus azjíes o chono Romani pinaga ma-aladík ṣo-o Airien lallum assaban Jerusalem.
standard: Todacho baas ai merien o assaban o chono i Judaea? Ta Ta Pontius Pilatus azjíes o chono Romani pinaga maaladík ṣoo Airien lallum assaban Jerusalem.

label: item_43
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did he cause the sufferings and death of Christ? Yes; the wicked Jews urgently insisted, and, from envy, demanded Christ's death while Pilate, as a wicked judge, consented by pronouncing against Christ the sentence or punishment of death.
form: Ja icho pinachoté, ṣo-o pinách'i ta Christus? Hena: rapies chono i Judaea madobdob inau sannan pach'i ta Christus, ṣo-o ta Pilatus maibas o rapies Airien, pauss'i decho, ṣo-o pattite o chachalt o machá kasjabaan ta Christus.
standard: Ja icho pinachoté, ṣoo pinách'i ta Christus? Hena: rapies chono i Judaea madobdob inau sannan pach'i ta Christus, ṣoo ta Pilatus maibas o rapies Airien, pauss'i decho, ṣoo pattite o chachalt o machá kasjabaan ta Christus.

label: item_44
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why did not God prevent His Son's being put to death? It was God's own will that His Son should suffer and be beaten by the wicked Jews, in order that, by His death, He might be a ransom for the transgressions of men.
form: Inaunumma ta Deos alli miel o micho, alla parras o choa sjiem, depa machá? Paga maunis a airab o Deos alla choa sjiem mamachoté ṣo-o allecho achan innai rapies chono i Judaea, alla lummaslas o choa machá o kakossi o babosa.
standard: Inaunumma ta Deos alli miel o micho, alla parras o choa sjiem, depa machá? Paga maunis a airab o Deos alla choa sjiem mamachoté ṣoo allecho achan innai rapies chono i Judaea, alla lummaslas o choa machá o kakossi o babosa.

label: item_45
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what way was Christ put to death? After they had beaten, mocked, and sorely ill-treated Christ, they nailed His hands and feet to a wooden cross, which they erected between two murderers, who were also nailed to the cross.
form: Moeda inipácha ta Christus? Ka ochal ṣimioch, mannacha, ṣo-o parapies o mauchus i ta Christus, decho tummiltil o choa rima a aṣiel i ṣaṣakimottono baron, ṣo-o pinase-ár aicho tuppach o narroa ma-ách'o cho tsiniltillan i baron channumma.
standard: Moeda inipácha ta Christus? Ka ochal ṣimioch, mannacha, ṣoo parapies o mauchus i ta Christus, decho tummiltil o choa rima a aṣiel i ṣaṣakimottono baron, ṣoo pinaseár aicho tuppach o narroa maách'o cho tsiniltillan i baron channumma.

label: item_46
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did Christ die on the cross of wood? Yes; and His dead body was buried, because it was really dead.
form: Ja minachá ta Christus i ṣaṣakimottono baron? Hena: ṣo-o choa bog o macháda, kachinap o ta, inau gagil mach'ija micho.
standard: Ja minachá ta Christus i ṣaṣakimottono baron? Hena: ṣoo choa bog o macháda, kachinap o ta, inau gagil mach'ija micho.

label: item_47
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does that signify - He has descended into the pit of fire, that is, hell? Did Christ bodily enter the fire of hell? No; these words are a simile of the fire of hell, and mean that the sufferings of Christ, body and soul, were truly as great, severe, and intense as if He actually had entered hellfire.
form: Numma micho a pattite, ṣinoss'i chauch o chau, ja ta Christus o choa bog ṣinoss'i chau o gehenna? Maini: atite o mini marach o tatschier innai chau o gehenna, ṣo-o pe'o lido o mini, alla machoté o ta Christus inni choa bog a tsjes gagil pinaga talcho a ma-atauch, a ma-aráas, a mato maibas o gagil ṣinoss'icho i chau o gehenna.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, ṣinoss'i chauch o chau, ja ta Christus o choa bog ṣinoss'i chau o gehenna? Maini: atite o mini marach o tatschier innai chau o gehenna, ṣoo pe'o lido o mini, alla machoté o ta Christus inni choa bog a tsjes gagil pinaga talcho a maatauch, a maaráas, a mato maibas o gagil ṣinoss'icho i chau o gehenna.

label: item_48
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the signification of these words - Gehenna, the pit of fire, and the flames of Gehenna? Gehenna is a pit or pool of fire, where God will eternally punish haibos and all wicked men.
form: Numm'ija lido o atite o mini, gehenna, chauch o chau, ṣo-o chau o gehenna? Gehenna paga, chauch o chau, dema ta Deos allecho pachoté i ta haibos taulaulan, ṣo-o tapos chono ma-arapies.
standard: Numm'ija lido o atite o mini, gehenna, chauch o chau, ṣoo chau o gehenna? Gehenna paga, chauch o chau, dema ta Deos allecho pachoté i ta haibos taulaulan, ṣoo tapos chono maarapies.

label: item_49
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Will the fire of hell never be extinguished? No; the wrath of God continually kindles hell-fire, and keeps it burning, so that all the wicked may be eternally punished.
form: Ja alli otuppen o chau o gehenna? Maini: rais o Deos tallochon pisor o chau i gehenna, ṣo-o maladik, ino-chote-in taulaulan tapos ja ma-arapies.
standard: Ja alli otuppen o chau o gehenna? Maini: rais o Deos tallochon pisor o chau i gehenna, ṣoo maladik, ino chotein taulaulan tapos ja maarapies.

label: item_50
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does true faith in the sufferings and death of Christ on the cross of wood give to your heart? The sufferings and death of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, on the cross, is the only sure consolation of my soul. On the cross I behold the true love of God and of His Son toward man: I see the wrath of God against sin, and the punishment of man's sin in His own Son; there I see many wounds and the blood of the Son of God covering-on account of my sins - His hands, feet, and whole body. Hence I am sure that the Son of God, Jesus Christ, has, through His sufferings and death in His human nature, truly paid the penalty for the transgressions of man, so that I may be delivered from the wrath of God, from the power and dominion of the devil, and from the punishment of hell-fire. Thus, when the wrath of God fills me with fear, I will deeply hide myself in the bloody wounds of the Son of God, so that the anger of His Father may pass by; and I shall most earnestly seek the forgiveness of sin, for the sake of the sufferings and death of His beloved Son, who has reconciled His Father to me.
form: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat o gagil inni machoté a macha o ta Christus i baron o ṣaṣakimotto? Machoté ṣo-o machá o ta Christus sjiem o Deos i baron o ṣaṣakimotto paga nattada tattalattal'o gagil o na-a tsjes; inni baron o ṣaṣakimotto na-a miall'o aukat o Deos, a choa sjiem pana babosa, na-a miall'o rais o Deos inau kakossi, ṣo-o chachalt o kakossi o babos'inni choa maunis a sjiem, na-a miall'o mapan soa, ṣo-o taḡḡ'o sjiem o Deos inni rim'a aṣiel, inni tapos choa bog inau na-a kakossi. Innai-numma kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus sjiem o Deos inni ḡa o babos'o choa machoté a machá linummaslas o kakossi o babosa, ino barrasan ja ina innai ikkil o rais o Deos, innai barra ṣo-o chachimit o haibos, ṣo-o innai chachalt o chau o gehenna. Sja rais o Deos pa-ikkil na-a tsjes, na-a papaddabo mauchus a ró inni ṣoa ma-ataḡḡ'o sjiem o Deos, alla pasji rais o choa tamau, na-a a-um-illo-ílono abono kakossi inau machoté a machá o choa aukattan a sjiem, tamasea pinabórr'o choa tamau na-a boa.
standard: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach i joa tsjes innai autat o gagil inni machoté a macha o ta Christus i baron o ṣaṣakimotto? Machoté ṣoo machá o ta Christus sjiem o Deos i baron o ṣaṣakimotto paga nattada tattalattal'o gagil o naa tsjes; inni baron o ṣaṣakimotto naa miall'o aukat o Deos, a choa sjiem pana babosa, naa miall'o rais o Deos inau kakossi, ṣoo chachalt o kakossi o babos'inni choa maunis a sjiem, naa miall'o mapan soa, ṣoo taḡḡ'o sjiem o Deos inni rim'a aṣiel, inni tapos choa bog inau naa kakossi. Innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus sjiem o Deos inni ḡa o babos'o choa machoté a machá linummaslas o kakossi o babosa, ino barrasan ja ina innai ikkil o rais o Deos, innai barra ṣoo chachimit o haibos, ṣoo innai chachalt o chau o gehenna. Sja rais o Deos paikkil naa tsjes, naa papaddabo mauchus a ró inni ṣoa maataḡḡ'o sjiem o Deos, alla pasji rais o choa tamau, naa aumilloílono abono kakossi inau machoté a machá o choa aukattan a sjiem, tamasea pinabórr'o choa tamau naa boa.

label: item_51
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: After Christ had died, where did His soul go to? To heaven.
form: Kamach'ija ta Christus ṣinosse dema choa tsjes-oë? I boesum ai.
standard: Kamach'ija ta Christus ṣinosse dema choa tsjesoë? I boesum ai.

label: item_52
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did His body see corruption in the grave? No: on the third day He returned to life, and rose from the dead.
form: Ja minabocho i robaan choa bog? Maini: kanatorroa-da zijsja pinaijoch o morich ja aicho, ṣo-o minaṣéas a machá.
standard: Ja minabocho i robaan choa bog? Maini: kanatorroada zijsja pinaijoch o morich ja aicho, ṣoo minaṣéas a machá.

label: item_53
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what way? The soul returned to the body, and was united again with His dead body.
form: Masanno? Kapinacheoach ja tsjes i bog, ṣo-o inaarpan o tattaul'o bog o machada ai.
standard: Masanno? Kapinacheoach ja tsjes i bog, ṣoo inaarpan o tattaul'o bog o machada ai.

label: item_54
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who did that? The Son of God did, by His own power, unite His soul with His dead body, and thus it became again living.
form: Tomm'ija minerien o micho? Ta sjiem o Deos o choa barra pinaarp'o tsjes o bog o machada, ṣo-o pinaijoch o morich ja aichoech.
standard: Tomm'ija minerien o micho? Ta sjiem o Deos o choa barra pinaarp'o tsjes o bog o machada, ṣoo pinaijoch o morich ja aichoech.

label: item_55
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Why did not Christ remain in death like all other persons? For three reasons: 1. He did not die for His own sins. 2. By His death He paid the full penalty for the transgression of man, therefore He did not remain in the grave like other men. 3. The dominion over life and death belongs to Him as the Son of God, and He has the power to give again life to the dead body.
form: Inaunumma alli machonṣar machá ta 'Christus maibas o tapos roman a babosa? Inau natorroá-da tuppo:- Kapesasa, alli minach'ija icho inau choa maunis a kakossi. Ka narroa, o choa machoté a machá linummaslas o auchos o kakossi o babosa; inau micho alli machonṣar o koemen i robaan, maibas o roman babosa. Ka natorroa, chachimit o morich a machá maunis icho maibas o sjiem o Deos; ṣo-o mabarra ja icho, paurich o bog o machá.
standard: Inaunumma alli machonṣar machá ta 'Christus maibas o tapos roman a babosa? Inau natorroáda tuppo:- Kapesasa, alli minach'ija icho inau choa maunis a kakossi. Ka narroa, o choa machoté a machá linummaslas o auchos o kakossi o babosa; inau micho alli machonṣar o koemen i robaan, maibas o roman babosa. Ka natorroa, chachimit o morich a machá maunis icho maibas o sjiem o Deos; ṣoo mabarra ja icho, paurich o bog o machá.

label: item_56
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does the resurrection of Christ from the dead give you? The resurrection of Christ from the dead proves that He is the true Son of God, who has trampled death under his feet, and has snapped asunder the bonds of death, and this gives me the assurance that Christ, who was confined in the grave for the sins of man, and who was delivered from death, has fully and completely paid and suffered the penalty for the transgressions of man; that He will likewise also deliver my body from the bonds of death, and through His strength will give it new life, although it has decayed and lain rotting in the grave.
form: Numm'ija tummalattala joa tsjes aṣéas o Christus a machá? Aṣéas o Christus a machá paita, alla choa paga gagil o sjiem o Deos, tamasea tsinummallas o machá de rapó cho'aṣiel, ṣo-o pinápil o kakoen o machá; innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus, o ai kakinoen i robaan inau kakossi o babosa, ṣo-o binarrasan a machá, oppen ja chinnummalt o kakossi o babosa; tamase'o mantas channumma paparras o na-a bog innai kakoen o machá, ṣo-o papaurich ai-oë o choa barra, pagatomma kamabocho i robaan.
standard: Numm'ija tummalattala joa tsjes aṣéas o Christus a machá? Aṣéas o Christus a machá paita, alla choa paga gagil o sjiem o Deos, tamasea tsinummallas o machá de rapó cho'aṣiel, ṣoo pinápil o kakoen o machá; innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus, o ai kakinoen i robaan inau kakossi o babosa, ṣoo binarrasan a machá, oppen ja chinnummalt o kakossi o babosa; tamase'o mantas channumma paparras o naa bog innai kakoen o machá, ṣoo papaurich aioë o choa barra, pagatomma kamabocho i robaan.

label: item_57
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did Christ, after He had again returned to life, remain on this earth? No; after forty days He ascended into heaven.
form: Kapaijoch o morich, ja pinoetach babó ta mini ta Christus? Maini: a-i-jor a narroa eis rummi-es tsinummaḡach i boesum-ech.
standard: Kapaijoch o morich, ja pinoetach babó ta mini ta Christus? Maini: aijor a narroa eis rummies tsinummaḡach i boesumech.

label: item_58
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What did He do on earth during these forty days? He appeared unto many who had formerly known Him; He showed them His living body, so that they might certainly know that He had again returned to life; and He commanded His twelve disciples, His servants, to go unto all nations, and to baptize them with water, in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.
form: Numm'ija icho merien de ta narroa eis rummi-es? Tsinummoach o mapan chono ai madarram ani icho, ṣo-o pait'o choa bog moricha, alla kamamachaggi dechonoë, kapaijoch o morich ja icho, ṣo-o pauss'o choa aran tschiet narroa cho, alla ṣaṣosse pattil o tapos o cho, ṣo-o sumkir i to i decho inni naan o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣo-o ta Auchar o Deos, Spirito Santo.
standard: Numm'ija icho merien de ta narroa eis rummies? Tsinummoach o mapan chono ai madarram ani icho, ṣoo pait'o choa bog moricha, alla kamamachaggi dechonoë, kapaijoch o morich ja icho, ṣoo pauss'o choa aran tschiet narroa cho, alla ṣaṣosse pattil o tapos o cho, ṣoo sumkir i to i decho inni naan o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣoo ta Auchar o Deos, Spirito Santo.

label: item_59
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How did Christ ascend into heaven? Having taken leave of His servants on a mountain, His body ascended on high, before their eyes, into the clouds; and while they were gazing towards heaven, two angels appeared, who testified that Christ would return in the same manner as they had seen Him ascend into heaven.
form: Moeda ṣinoss'i boesum ta Christus? Kapoberies o choa aran babó nattada ranna, inalappoon ja choa bog lallum nattada rabbo pana babó katinnaam o choa machá ṣo-o kamabaddabadd'o boesum dechonoë, tsinummoach narroa-da Angelus, o ai pinaba, alla masiniṣar ṣaṣai pacheoach ta Christus, maibas decho minit'ichoṣar tummaḡach i boesum.
standard: Moeda ṣinoss'i boesum ta Christus? Kapoberies o choa aran babó nattada ranna, inalappoon ja choa bog lallum nattada rabbo pana babó katinnaam o choa machá ṣoo kamabaddabadd'o boesum dechonoë, tsinummoach narroada Angelus, o ai pinaba, alla masiniṣar ṣaṣai pacheoach ta Christus, maibas decho minit'ichoṣar tummaḡach i boesum.

label: item_60
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does Christ remain in heaven? Yes; till the day of general judgment.
form: Ja machonṣar inni boesum ta Christus? Hena: ate zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho.
standard: Ja machonṣar inni boesum ta Christus? Hena: ate zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho.

label: item_61
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: With what purpose did Christ ascend into heaven? That He might open heaven, which was closed against us on account of our sins, and that He might continually be our Intercessor with the Father.
form: Inonumma ṣinoss'i boesum ta Christus? Alla tatummann'o boesum, o ai kinapos inau torroa kakossi, ṣo-o papaga tallochon torroa ma-azinado katinnaam o choa tamau.
standard: Inonumma ṣinoss'i boesum ta Christus? Alla tatummann'o boesum, o ai kinapos inau torroa kakossi, ṣoo papaga tallochon torroa maazinado katinnaam o choa tamau.

label: item_62
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does that signify - Sitting on the right hand of His Father Almighty? Has God a right hand? Does Christ, as a human being, sit in heaven, on the right hand of His Father? No; these words are taken from a simile of the kings of the earth, who put their nearest and most excellent compeers on their right hand, and thus signify that Christ also, as man, occupies the highest and most glorious place in heaven, above all angels and men, having received a name above all names, and possessing, next to His Father, all dominion and power, be it in heaven or on earth, so that He may subdue all His enemies, and protect His own people- to wit, all those who believe in Him, and love His name.
form: Numma micho a pattite, airoossen i kallamas o choa tamau, kamabarr'ija tapos ó ai; ja ta Deos paga rima ja kallamas; ja ta Christus maibas o babosa mero-os inni boesum i kallamas o choa tamau? Maini: atite o mini marach o tatschier innai mario-acho de ta, tamasea pairo-os o choa ara, o ai maso macháddik a matásso, i choa kallamas, ṣo-o paita, alla masini channumma ta Christus, maibas o babosa, kummasjies a maro a matasso i boesum babó tapos Angelus a babosa, tamasea minarach o naan babo tapos o naan, ṣo-o a-i-jor a choa tamau paga chachimit o tapos a barra pagatomma de boesum, pagatomma de ta, alla pauloan o tapos cho'ázjies-in, ṣo-o maladik o choa maunis a cho; tapos chono ai ka poetautat inni choa boa, ṣo-o maukat o choa naan.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, airoossen i kallamas o choa tamau, kamabarr'ija tapos ó ai; ja ta Deos paga rima ja kallamas; ja ta Christus maibas o babosa meroos inni boesum i kallamas o choa tamau? Maini: atite o mini marach o tatschier innai mario a cho de ta, tamasea pairoos o choa ara, o ai maso macháddik a matásso, i choa kallamas, ṣoo paita, alla masini channumma ta Christus, maibas o babosa, kummasjies a maro a matasso i boesum babó tapos Angelus a babosa, tamasea minarach o naan babo tapos o naan, ṣoo aijor a choa tamau paga chachimit o tapos a barra pagatomma de boesum, pagatomma de ta, alla pauloan o tapos cho'ázjiesin, ṣoo maladik o choa maunis a cho; tapos chono ai ka poetautat inni choa boa, ṣoo maukat o choa naan.

label: item_63
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Will Christ return again from heaven? Yes; He will appear in the clouds, as the Judge of all men.
form: Ja papaijoch innai boesum ta Christus? Hena: tatummoach i rabbo maibas o ma-achachalt o tapos o cho.
standard: Ja papaijoch innai boesum ta Christus? Hena: tatummoach i rabbo maibas o maachachalt o tapos o cho.

label: item_64
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: When? At the end of heaven and earth and of all things. No man knows when that day will come.
form: Ṣabanno? Kaṣisi o boesum, a ta, ṣo-o mini tapos ai: allipa ja cho mab'o zijsja aicho-ech.
standard: Ṣabanno? Kaṣisi o boesum, a ta, ṣoo mini tapos ai: allipa ja cho mab'o zijsja aichoech.

label: item_65
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What will He do? He will sit on His throne in the clouds, and will send His servants, the angels, to assemble all men; the graves shall render their dead, and the sea shall render its dead, and all men then living, as well as those who have died before, shall appear before the judgment-seat of Jesus Christ, to be rewarded according to their works. Then Christ will pronounce sentence on all men, and cast the wicked into hell-fire, but the righteous and His friends He will lead into the joys of heaven.
form: Mamerien onumm'ichonoë? Mamero-os i babó choa ba o rasan lallum rabbo, ṣo-o allecho pauss'o choa aran, ta Angelus, alla paidarr'o tapos o cho: robaan pape'o choa macháda, ṣo-o abas pape'o choa machada, ṣo-o patapos babosa, morich-a ja ani machá tatummoach katinnaam o ba o rasan o ma-achachalt ta Jesus Christus, alla marach o chachad kamaibas o choa tataap. Kasach-á ta Christus papattite o chachalt o tapos o cho, ṣo-o papa-itis o tapos ma-arapies i chau o gehenna; kasjabaan papa-i-jor o ma-bisse tsjes chonoë, ṣo-o choa aukattan a cho i aukat o boesum-ech.
standard: Mamerien onumm'ichonoë? Mameroos i babó choa ba o rasan lallum rabbo, ṣoo allecho pauss'o choa aran, ta Angelus, alla paidarr'o tapos o cho: robaan pape'o choa macháda, ṣoo abas pape'o choa machada, ṣoo patapos babosa, moricha ja ani machá tatummoach katinnaam o ba o rasan o maachachalt ta Jesus Christus, alla marach o chachad kamaibas o choa tataap. Kasachá ta Christus papattite o chachalt o tapos o cho, ṣoo papaitis o tapos maarapies i chau o gehenna; kasjabaan papaijor o mabisse tsjes chonoë, ṣoo choa aukattan a cho i aukat o boesumech.

label: item_66
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does your belief, that Christ has ascended into heaven and that He will return to judge the quick and the dead, give to your heart? It gives me the sure conviction that Christ, my Head, is raised above all my enemies, that He has obtained heaven for me, and that He continually intercedes for me, in order to reconcile His Father to me; and that I also expect Him to come from heaven on the day of general judgment, in order that He may cast His and my enemies into hell-fire, and that He may give me a place in heaven with Him, as He spake to His Father, ' I will that where I am, my servants shall be also.'
form: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach moach i joa tsjes, inau poetautat ijonoë alla ta Christus ṣinoss'i boesum, ṣo-o ṣaṣai pacheoach, alla merien o chachalt o cho moricha ṣo-o macháda ai? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus na-a oeno paga babó tapos na-a ázjies-in, tamasea pinaaunis o boesum ina, ṣo-o tallochon paz-inado alla pabórr'o choa tamau na-a boa; o ai na-a tummassin channumma innai boesum ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho, alla pa-itis o choa ṣo-o na-a micho ázjies-in i chau o gehenna, ṣo-o paubarri ina rorró icho inni boesum, maibaṣṣar pinal'o choa tamau, na-a merab, alla dema paga ina, na-a aran paga channumma.
standard: Numm'ija tattalattala tummoach moach i joa tsjes, inau poetautat ijonoë alla ta Christus ṣinoss'i boesum, ṣoo ṣaṣai pacheoach, alla merien o chachalt o cho moricha ṣoo macháda ai? Innai micho kamachaggi ja ina, alla ta Christus naa oeno paga babó tapos naa ázjiesin, tamasea pinaaunis o boesum ina, ṣoo tallochon pazinado alla pabórr'o choa tamau naa boa; o ai naa tummassin channumma innai boesum ka zijsj'o chachalt o tapos o cho, alla paitis o choa ṣoo naa micho ázjiesin i chau o gehenna, ṣoo paubarri ina rorró icho inni boesum, maibaṣṣar pinal'o choa tamau, naa merab, alla dema paga ina, naa aran paga channumma.

label: item_67
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who is the third Person in God's being? The Breath of God, the Holy Ghost.
form: Tomm'ija ka natorroa-da boa inni ḡa o Deos-ṣar? Ta Auchar o Deos o maachimit ta Spirito Santo.
standard: Tomm'ija ka natorroada boa inni ḡa o Deosṣar? Ta Auchar o Deos o maachimit ta Spirito Santo.

label: item_68
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you believe in the Holy Ghost? Yes; I believe at the same time in the Father, in the Son, and in the Breath of God, the Holy Ghost, because these three Persons are the only and true God.
form: Ja poetautat ijonoë inni ta Spirito Santo? Hena: na-a poetautat maibasṣar a rorró inni o tamau, inni ta sjiem, ṣo-o inni ta Auchar o Deos, Spirito Santo, inau natorroada bo'o mini paga nattaṣar ai, ṣo-o gagil o Deos.
standard: Ja poetautat ijonoë inni ta Spirito Santo? Hena: naa poetautat maibasṣar a rorró inni o tamau, inni ta sjiem, ṣoo inni ta Auchar o Deos, Spirito Santo, inau natorroada bo'o mini paga nattaṣar ai, ṣoo gagil o Deos.

label: item_69
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does that signify - I believe in the Breath of God, the Holy Ghost? That signifies - I know for certain from the testimony of God's Word, and am firmly convinced in my mind, that the Holy Ghost jointly proceeds from the Father and from the Son, being very God of God, who infuses or breathes heavenly thoughts, and conducts us in the way of God's commandments.
form: Numma micho a pattite, na-a poetautat inni ta Auchar o Deos o ma-achimit, ta Spirito Santo? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣo-o poetat o na-a tsjes, alla ta Spirito Santo ṣosse rorró innai o tamau, ṣo-o innai ta sjiem, gagil o Deos innai Deosṣar, tamasea pauchar o tattupp'o boesum, ṣo-o pa-i-jor i tarran o atillono Deos.
standard: Numma micho a pattite, naa poetautat inni ta Auchar o Deos o maachimit, ta Spirito Santo? Micho a pattite, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣoo poetat o naa tsjes, alla ta Spirito Santo ṣosse rorró innai o tamau, ṣoo innai ta sjiem, gagil o Deos innai Deosṣar, tamasea pauchar o tattupp'o boesum, ṣoo paijor i tarran o atillono Deos.

label: item_70
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the peculiar and especial work of these three Persons? God the Father is the Creator of heaven and earth, and of the sea, because it was He who first began to make all things, and caused His Son, as also the Holy Ghost, to join in this work; the Son of God is the Redeemer of man, because He in His person, and according to His human nature, is the Mediator and Intercessor between God and man; the Holy Ghost is the Comforter of the children of God, because He dwells in their hearts, and constantly comforts them.
form: Numm'ija maunis a tataap o natorroa-da bo'o mini? Deos o tamau paga Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, inau icho tsinummaas o merien o mini tapos ai, ṣo-o pinaisas'i ta sjiem a ta Spirito Santo karri-tataap; ta sjiem o Deos paga ma-ababárras o babosa, inau inni choa boa, ṣo-o inni ḡa o babosa paga ma-áborra a ma-ázinado tuppach o Deos a babosa; ta Spirito Santo paga ma-attaláttal'o sisjiem o Deos, inau ṣummos'i choa tsjes, ṣo-o tallochon tummalattal'i decho.
standard: Numm'ija maunis a tataap o natorroada bo'o mini? Deos o tamau paga Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas, inau icho tsinummaas o merien o mini tapos ai, ṣoo pinaisas'i ta sjiem a ta Spirito Santo karritataap; ta sjiem o Deos paga maabarárras o babosa, inau inni choa boa, ṣoo inni ḡa o babosa paga maáborra a maázinado tuppach o Deos a babosa; ta Spirito Santo paga maattaláttal'o sisjiem o Deos, inau ṣummos'i choa tsjes, ṣoo tallochon tummalattal'i decho.

label: item_71
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Thus the Holy Ghost comforts our hearts? He appropriates unto us the sufferings and death of Christ, in order that we may escape, and be exempted from the punishment of sin; thereupon He breathes into our hearts good will and thoughts, so that we, as new creatures, may take delight in the works of righteousness, and imitate the life of our Lord Jesus Christ; thereby testifying unto our spirits that we truly are children of God.
form: Moeda ta Spirito Santo tummalattal'i torroa tsjes? Icho paaunis torroa bo'o machoté a machá o ta Christus, ṣo-o choa tataap o babissé, ino barrasan ja torro innai chachalt o kakossi; kasach-á pauchar i torroa tsjes o airaba tattuppau mario, alla maibas o bao a cho torro maukat o tataap o babissé, ṣo-o tsimichier o morich o ta Jesus Christus, torroa micho ma-achachimit, innai-numm'icho pab'i torroa tsjes, alla torro paga gagil sisjiem o Deos.
standard: Moeda ta Spirito Santo tummalattal'i torroa tsjes? Icho paaunis torroa bo'o machoté a machá o ta Christus, ṣoo choa tataap o babissé, ino barrasan ja torro innai chachalt o kakossi; kasachá pauchar i torroa tsjes o airaba tattuppau mario, alla maibas o bao a cho torro maukat o tataap o babissé, ṣoo tsimichier o morich o ta Jesus Christus, torroa micho maachachimit, innainumm'icho pab'i torroa tsjes, alla torro paga gagil sisjiem o Deos.

label: item_72
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What consolation does true faith in the Holy Ghost afford you? That God, the Father, has given me the Holy Ghost, so that He may constantly abide with me and comfort me in affliction; that He sheds abroad in my heart His gifts, such as peace, rest, and the love of God; from which I may be assured that God the Father loves me, and that He has granted me eternal life, for the sake of His beloved Son Jesus Christ. Having then spoken on faith in God, we have now to consider the faith of God's people.
form: Numm'ija tummalattala joa tsjes autat o gagil inni ta Spirito Santo? Alla Deos o tamau pinassósó ina ta Spirito Santo, alla papára tallochon ina, ṣo-o tummalattal'inni zichil, tamasea summa-od o choa aṣoso i na-a tsjes, maibas o áborra, árra, ṣo-o aukat o Deos, innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, alla Deos o tamau maukat o ina, ṣo-o pinassosono morich o ma-áchonṣar ina, inau choa aukattan a sjiem ta Jesus Christus. A-i-jor a autat inni ta Deos ummior o autat o chono Deos.
standard: Numm'ija tummalattala joa tsjes autat o gagil inni ta Spirito Santo? Alla Deos o tamau pinassósó ina ta Spirito Santo, alla papára tallochon ina, ṣoo tummalattal'inni zichil, tamasea summaod o choa aṣoso i naa tsjes, maibas o áborra, árra, ṣoo aukat o Deos, innainumma kamachaggi ja ina, alla Deos o tamau maukat o ina, ṣoo pinassosono morich o maáchonṣar ina, inau choa aukattan a sjiem ta Jesus Christus. Aijor a autat inni ta Deos ummior o autat o chono Deos.

label: item_73
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has God a peculiar people here on earth? Yes, He has.
form: Ja ta Deos paga maunis a cho de ta mini? Paga.
standard: Ja ta Deos paga maunis a cho de ta mini? Paga.

label: item_74
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Are all men the peculiar and beloved people of God? No; God chooses a peculiar people and beloved children from all the generations of the earth.
form: Ja tapos o babosa paga maunis, ṣo-o aukattan a chono Deos? Maini: ta Deos piri o maunis a cho ṣo-o aukattan a sisjiem innai tapos o tupponodon de ta.
standard: Ja tapos o babosa paga maunis, ṣoo aukattan a chono Deos? Maini: ta Deos piri o maunis a cho ṣoo aukattan a sisjiem innai tapos o tupponodon de ta.

label: item_75
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who are they? All true believers are children of God.
form: Tomm'ija decho? Tapos o gagil ma-autat a cho paga sisjiem o Deos.
standard: Tomm'ija decho? Tapos o gagil maautat a cho paga sisjiem o Deos.

label: item_76
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does this signify - I believe in the community of a pure and holy Christian people, which has been from of old, now is, and always shall remain. It signifies - The testimony of God's Word assures me - and I believe this with all my heart - that God the Father has a peculiar and holy people who, from the beginning to the final end of this world, are gathered together; that they are called by the Word of God from all the generations of the world unto an eternal and heavenly life, to be united with God in His Son Jesus Christ in one body, they being joined together in true faith.
form: Numma micho a patitte: na-a pittau o aiḡarrorro-no cho Christan o ma-achimit, o ai pinaga ani aicho, paga pia, ṣo-o kapapoetautachṣar? Michoṣar a patitte, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣo-o pittau'o na-a tsjes, alla Deos o tamau paga adokken a chono maachimit, o ai ipaiḡarrórro innai aisas'ate ṣisi o mini tapos ai, ṣo-o aloddan o ranied o Deos innai tapos o tupponodon de ta pana morich o ma-áchonṣar i boesum, ino aarpanni i ta Deos inni choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus pana nattaṣar achieb, barroon o rorró inni autat o gagil.
standard: Numma micho a patitte: naa pittau o aiḡarrorrono cho Christan o maachimit, o ai pinaga ani aicho, paga pia, ṣoo kapapoetautachṣar? Michoṣar a patitte, kamachaggi ja ina innai al'o ranied o Deos, ṣoo pittau'o naa tsjes, alla Deos o tamau paga adokken a chono maachimit, o ai ipaiḡarrórro innai aisas'ate ṣisi o mini tapos ai, ṣoo aloddan o ranied o Deos innai tapos o tupponodon de ta pana morich o maáchonṣar i boesum, ino aarpanni i ta Deos inni choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus pana nattaṣar achieb, barroon o rorró inni autat o gagil.

label: item_77
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does not the gathering together of the believers cease in this world? No; when some die, others are added: God the Father chooses them according to His good pleasure. The Son of God gathers them by the power of His Word; reconciles, redeems, and guards over the elect, so that they may not perish. The Holy Ghost dwells in their souls, and continually abides with them, enlightens their minds, inspires them with heavenly thoughts, increases their knowledge of and faith in God, so that it may not be extinguished; purifies body and soul, and renders them fit to be united with God. The entire gathering of all believers is like unto one body, which is composed of many members: each individual believer is, as it were, a member of this body. The Son of God is the true Head who quickens the body and all its members. God the Father is the Founder of the family, and calls the believers His children. The Holy Ghost, through medium of His power, reigns over the house. In this way, the three Persons, God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost, render the body of the believers gathered together perfect, in order that it should increase and grow in knowledge and true faith, closely united to one another by mutual love. In the meetings of the believers God is really acknowledged and called upon; He dwells in the midst of them, therefore they are called the house of God, the meeting of God, His children, and members of the family, a chosen race, a holy and ransomed people, whereas they who do not know God are strangers, and, as it were, without God.
form: Ja aiḡarrórrono ma-autat a cho alli moribal de ta mini? Maini: kamach'ija roman, chippan ja roman Deos o tamau ummadok kamaibas o aukat o cho'airab. Ta sjiem o Deos paiḡarrórro inni barr'o choa ranied, lummaslas, parras, ṣo-o maladik o adokken a cho, depa moribal. Ta Auchar o Deos o ma-achimit summos'i choa tsjes, alla tallochon o par'i decho, párar'o choa ṣaan, pauchar i tsjes o tattupp'o boesum, pauab o aba ṣo-o autat inni ta Deos, depa otuppen, pachímit o bog a tsjes, ṣo-o paatsikap i decho, ino aarpanni i ta Deos. Aiḡarrórro ma-arummóno tapos o maautat a cho paga maibas o nattaṣar achieb, o ai rorró-no aarpanni innai mapan a raag. Atatta ma-aunionis o ma-autat a cho paga maibas o raag o achieb o mini. Ta sjiem o Deos paga oeno o gagil, o ai paurich o achieb, ṣo-o tapos o choa raag. Deos o tamau pauchodon a arie-eddan, ṣo-o pattonan o maautat acho choa sisjiem. Ta Auchar o ma-achimit o choa barra chummimit o don o Deos. Masiniṣar natorroa-da boa, Deos o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣo-o Auchar o ma-achimit rorróno ummoob o achieb o aiḡarrorrono ma-autat a cho, alla moab ṣo-o summoos o mató inni aba ṣo-o autat o gagil, barroon o didden o karri-aukat. Inni aiḡarrorrono ma-autat a cho darrammen o gagil ṣo-o eachanni ta Deos, ṣo-o summos'o inni babat o decho; inau decho attonannanṣar don o Deos, aiḡarrorrono chono Deos, choa sisjiem ṣo-o ari-eddan, adókken a tupponodon, chono maachimit, laslas-en a cho. Kasjabaan chono mautsiri i ta Deos, paga azjíes ṣo-o maibas o marotul i ta Deos.
standard: Ja aiḡarrórrono maautat a cho alli moribal de ta mini? Maini: kamach'ija roman, chippan ja roman Deos o tamau ummadok kamaibas o aukat o cho'airab. Aiḡarrórro maarummóno tapos o maautat a cho paga maibas o nattaṣar achieb, o ai rorróno aarpanni innai mapan a raag. Atatta maaunionis o maautat a cho paga maibas o raag o achieb o mini. Ta sjiem o Deos paga oeno o gagil, o ai paurich o achieb, ṣoo tapos o choa raag. Deos o tamau pauchodon a arieeddan, ṣoo pattonan o maautat acho choa sisjiem. Ta Auchar o maachimit o choa barra chummimit o don o Deos. Masiniṣar natorroada boa, Deos o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣoo Auchar o maachimit rorróno ummoob o achieb o aiḡarrorrono maautat a cho, alla moab ṣoo summoos o mató inni aba ṣoo autat o gagil, barroon o didden o karriaukat. Inni aiḡarrorrono maautat a cho darrammen o gagil ṣoo eachanni ta Deos, ṣoo summos'o inni babat o decho; inau decho attonannanṣar don o Deos, aiḡarrorrono chono Deos, choa sisjiem ṣoo arieddan, adókken a tupponodon, chono maachimit, laslasen a cho. Kasjabaan chono mautsiri i ta Deos, paga azjíes ṣoo maibas o marotul i ta Deos.

label: item_78
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you only believe in the community of the holy? No; I also believe that I am incorporated into the body of these meetings; that is, through faith, I have become a living member thereof, in which I shall also remain.
form: Ja pittau o baak ijonoë o aiḡarrorrono chono ma-achimit? Maini: na-a channumma pittau all'inaarpan ja in'o achieb o aiḡarrorrono innai autat o gagil, maibas o raag o morich, o ai na-a mamachonṣar channumma.
standard: Ja pittau o baak ijonoë o aiḡarrorrono chono maachimit? Maini: naa channumma pittau all'inaarpan ja in'o achieb o aiḡarrorrono innai autat o gagil, maibas o raag o morich, o ai naa mamachonṣar channumma.

label: item_79
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does God grant the believers? His gifts and manifold blessings, of which three of the most important may be thus enumerated: - the forgiveness of trespasses, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.
form: Numm'ija ta Deos passosono ma-autat a cho? Mapan choa aṣosó a tataap o rio, ṣo-o niaso matasso natorroa, o ai toch-en insini, maibas o ábono tataap o kakossi, aṣeas o boa, ṣo-o morich o ma-achonṣar.
standard: Numm'ija ta Deos passosono maautat a cho? Mapan choa aṣosó a tataap o rio, ṣoo niaso matasso natorroa, o ai tochen insini, maibas o ábono tataap o kakossi, aṣeas o boa, ṣoo morich o maachonṣar.

label: item_80
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do all believers receive these gifts? Yes; all true believers participate in the benefits and gifts of God.
form: Ja tapos o ma-autat a cho marach o aṣosono mini? Hena: tapos o gagil ma-autat a cho paga rorróno ad'inni tataap o rio ṣo-o aṣosóno Deos.
standard: Ja tapos o maautat a cho marach o aṣosono mini? Hena: tapos o gagil maautat a cho paga rorróno ad'inni tataap o rio ṣoo aṣosóno Deos.

label: item_81
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you believe in the communion of saints? Yes; I do.
form: Ja pittau ijonoë o rorróno ad'o chono ma-achimit? Hena.
standard: Ja pittau ijonoë o rorróno ad'o chono maachimit? Hena.

label: item_82
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Explain this: What is the communion of saints? The communion of saints means, that all believers, who remain united with God in His Son Jesus Christ, jointly participate in the redemption and righteousness of Christ, and in the other gifts of God.
form: Ipabá numm'ija rorróno ad'o chono ma-achimit? Rorró-no ad'o chono ma-achimit michoṣar a pattite, alla tapos o ma-autat a cho, o ai machonṣar aarpanni i ta Deos inni choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus rorró-no marach o ad'inni lalaslas a babissé o ta Christus, ṣo-o roma-roman aṣósono Deos.
standard: Ipabá numm'ija rorróno ad'o chono maachimit? Rorróno ad'o chono maachimit michoṣar a pattite, alla tapos o maautat a cho, o ai machonṣar aarpanni i ta Deos inni choa sjiem ta Jesus Christus rorróno marach o ad'inni lalaslas a babissé o ta Christus, ṣoo romaroman aṣósono Deos.

label: item_83
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Is there also a mutual communion of saints? Yes, there is; for all believers should mutually assist their neighbours with their gifts, and lead each other heavenwards.
form: Ja paga karri-ad'o chono maachimit channumma? Hena: inau tapos o ma-autat a cho maspot a karri-a-olli-eul o choa aṣoṣono ma-achaddik o cho, ṣo-o karri-a-i-jor pana boesum ai.
standard: Ja paga karriad'o chono maachimit channumma? Hena: inau tapos o maautat a cho maspot a karriaollieul o choa aṣoṣono maachaddik o cho, ṣoo karriaijor pana boesum ai.

label: item_84
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who are those saints? True believers are called saints, because the blood of Christ has cleansed them from their iniquity and trespasses, and because they commence a new life in all the righteousness of God?
form: Tomm'ija chono ma-achimit o micho? Gagil o ma-autat a cho attonannanṣar chono ma-achimit, inau orichen ja decho inni taḡḡ'o ta Christus innai choa arapies a kakossi, ṣo-o tummalpon o bao a morich inni tapos o babissé o Deos.
standard: Tomm'ija chono maachimit o micho? Gagil o maautat a cho attonannanṣar chono maachimit, inau orichen ja decho inni taḡḡ'o ta Christus innai choa arapies a kakossi, ṣoo tummalpon o bao a morich inni tapos o babissé o Deos.

label: item_85
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you also believe in the forgiveness of sins? Yes; I surely do believe that God the Father, for the sake of His Son Jesus Christ, forgives all my transgressions and the wickedness of my heart, whereof I sincerely repent; and, on the other hand, grants me the righteousness and holiness of Christ, so that I may be delivered from the punishment of sin.
form: Ja pittau ijonoë ábono tataap o kakossi? Hena: na-a pittau o gagil alla Deos o tamau inau lalaslas o choa sjiem ta Christus mabono auchos tapos na-a kakossi, ṣo-o arapies o tsjes, o ai machi'o gagil ina, ṣo-o passoso ina kasjabaan o babissé a chimit o ta Christus, ino barrasan; innai chachalt o kakossi ina-e.
standard: Ja pittau ijonoë ábono tataap o kakossi? Hena: naa pittau o gagil alla Deos o tamau inau lalaslas o choa sjiem ta Christus mabono auchos tapos naa kakossi, ṣoo arapies o tsjes, o ai machi'o gagil ina, ṣoo passoso ina kasjabaan o babissé a chimit o ta Christus, ino barrasan; innai chachalt o kakossi inae.

label: item_86
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What do you believe as regards the resurrection of the body? I believe that my body, though lying in corruption in the grave, will at the end of the world be raised from the dead, and will be again united with my soul, so that it may be taken up into heaven, and be made conformable to Christ.
form: Pittau onúmm'ijonoë innai aṣeas o bo'ai? Na-a pittau alla na-a micho bog, pagatomma mabocho i robaan, ka ṣisi o mini tapos ai allecho ipaṣeas a machá, ṣo-o aarpanni o tattaul'o na-a tsjes, ino alappan i boesum, ṣo-o ipaibas i ta Christus.
standard: Pittau onúmm'ijonoë innai aṣeas o bo'ai? Naa pittau alla naa micho bog, pagatomma mabocho i robaan, ka ṣisi o mini tapos ai allecho ipaṣeas a machá, ṣoo aarpanni o tattaul'o naa tsjes, ino alappan i boesum, ṣoo ipaibas i ta Christus.

label: item_87
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Will the self-same body that has been dead be raised again? Yes.
form: Ja allecho ipáṣeas maunis a bog, o ai minacha? Hena.
standard: Ja allecho ipáṣeas maunis a bog, o ai minacha? Hena.

label: item_88
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Well now, with its flesh decayed and corrupted, how can the body again come forth? God, who has made the body of the dust, shall make the dead body again alive out of the dust, by His divine power.
form: Oedan, kamabocho choa boa, innainumma tatummoach o bogṣar? Ta Deos o ai minerien o bog innai borrabor, allecho paurich o tattaul'o bog o machad'innai borrabor o choa barr'o Deos-ṣar.
standard: Oedan, kamabocho choa boa, innainumma tatummoach o bogṣar? Ta Deos o ai minerien o bog innai borrabor, allecho paurich o tattaul'o bog o machad'innai borrabor o choa barr'o Deosṣar.

label: item_89
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Will the body be raised to perish again? No; I believe in eternal life after this life.
form: Ja allecho ipaṣeas ma-auribal a bog? Maini: na-a pittau o morich o ma-áchonṣar, a-i-jor a morich o mini.
standard: Ja allecho ipaṣeas maauribal a bog? Maini: naa pittau o morich o maáchonṣar, aijor a morich o mini.

label: item_90
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is life eternal? Eternal life is an imperishable life in heaven, where we shall behold God face to face; where we shall have peace, rest, and rejoicing of the heart, without end; which the eye hath not seen, neither ear heard, nor the heart and thought have ever conceived. Amen.
form: Numm'ija morich o ma-áchonṣar? Morich o ma-áchonṣar paga morich i boesum o ai alli moribal, inninumma pagaga ai-all'o ta Deos, áborra, arra, ṣo-o aukat o tsjes, paṣisi-ech, o ai machá alli minita, charrina alli minaṣini, ṣo-o alli tsinummaap tsjes a tattuppa; Amen.
standard: Numm'ija morich o maáchonṣar? Morich o maáchonṣar paga morich i boesum o ai alli moribal, inninumma pagaga aiall'o ta Deos, áborra, arra, ṣoo aukat o tsjes, paṣisiech, o ai machá alli minita, charrina alli minaṣini, ṣoo alli tsinummaap tsjes a tattuppa; Amen.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: title
notes: Printed Favorlang section heading aligned to Campbell's English heading
translation: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism.
form: Ma-ápapp'a Atil ino Arácho Christan a Sasikir i to.
standard: Maápapp'a Atil ino Arácho Christan a Sasikir i to.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_01
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What is the Christian doctrine The Christian doctrine is a doctrine found in the Word of God, of His being and works.
form: Numm'ija atil o Christan? Atil o Christan paga atil o ranied o Deos innai choa micho ḡa ṣo-o choa tataap.
standard: Numm'ija atil o Christan? Atil o Christan paga atil o ranied o Deos innai choa micho ḡa ṣoo choa tataap.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_02
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How many Gods are there? There is but one true God.
form: Naida Deos paḡa ja? Paga nattaṣar ḡaḡil o Deos.
standard: Naida Deos paḡa ja? Paga nattaṣar ḡaḡil o Deos.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_03
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who is the true God? The true God is Jehovah, Creator of heaven, the earth, and the sea.
form: Tomm'ija Deos o gagil o micho? Deos o gagil paga ta Jehova, Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas.
standard: Tomm'ija Deos o gagil o micho? Deos o gagil paga ta Jehova, Airien o boesum, o ta, a abas.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_04
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does the written Word of God declare concerning God's being? That His being is peculiar, not like unto our body.
form: Pab'ija onumma kabidoan ranied o Deos innai ḡa o Deos-ṣar? Alla maunionis choa ḡa, alli maibas o bogṣar.
standard: Pab'ija onumma kabidoan ranied o Deos innai ḡa o Deosṣar? Alla maunionis choa ḡa, alli maibas o bogṣar.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_05
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has God no body, or bodily form? No; He is essentially a spirit, without body or flesh, and His being or person is not visible.
form: Ja alli paḡa bog, ja isas o bogṣar ta Deos? Maini: paḡa tsjes o auchos icho, marotul o bog a boa, ṣo-o pa itan choa ḡa ja boa.
standard: Ja alli paḡa bog, ja isas o bogṣar ta Deos? Maini: paḡa tsjes o auchos icho, marotul o bog a boa, ṣoo pa itan choa ḡa ja boa.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_06
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How many persons do there exist in God's being? There are three separate persons: the Father, the Son, and the pure breath, the Holy Ghost.
form: Naida boa paḡa ini ḡa o Deosṣar. Kamaunionis natorroa-da boa, o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣo-o ta Auchar o ma-áchimit, ta Spirito Santo.
standard: Naida boa paḡa ini ḡa o Deosṣar. Kamaunionis natorroada boa, o tamau, ta sjiem, ṣoo ta Auchar o maáchimit, ta Spirito Santo.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_07
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Are they not three separate Gods? No; because they form together one being of God.
form: Ja alli maunionis natorroa Deos dechonoë? Maini: inau dechoa rorró paga nattada ḡa o Deos.
standard: Ja alli maunionis natorroa Deos dechonoë? Maini: inau dechoa rorró paga nattada ḡa o Deos.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_08
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you believe in God? Yes; I truly believe that there is one God in three persons.
form: Ja poetautat inni ta Deos ijonoë? Hena: na-a pittau o ḡaḡil alla paga nattaṣar a Deos inni natorroada boa.
standard: Ja poetautat inni ta Deos ijonoë? Hena: naa pittau o ḡaḡil alla paga nattaṣar a Deos inni natorroada boa.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_09
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does the Word of God declare concerning His works? That in the beginning God made heaven and earth, and all these things.
form: Pab'ija onumma ranied o Deos innai choa tataap? Alla ta Deos inni aisasa minerien o boesum a ta, ṣo-o mini tapos ai.
standard: Pab'ija onumma ranied o Deos innai choa tataap? Alla ta Deos inni aisasa minerien o boesum a ta, ṣoo mini tapos ai.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_10
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does He sustain, keep, and reign over all things? Yes; He sustains them by His power, and He governs according to His pleasure (will).
form: Ja icho tumka, maladik, ṣo-o chummimit channumm'o tapos ai? Hena: icho tumk'o tapos ai o choa barra, ṣo-o chummimit, kamaibas o choa airab.
standard: Ja icho tumka, maladik, ṣoo chummimit channumm'o tapos ai? Hena: icho tumk'o tapos ai o choa barra, ṣoo chummimit, kamaibas o choa airab.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_11
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Did God make man also in the beginning? Yes; He made two, man and woman, from whom have sprung all the generations of the earth.
form: Ja ta Deos inni aisasa minerien o babosa channumma? Hena: minerienṣar o narroa cho, sjam a ṣini, innai tamasea tsinummoach tapos o tupponodon de ta.
standard: Ja ta Deos inni aisasa minerien o babosa channumma? Hena: minerienṣar o narroa cho, sjam a ṣini, innai tamasea tsinummoach tapos o tupponodon de ta.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_12
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what way did God make man in the beginning? God made man in His image, to be an image of God, that is to say, altogether righteous.
form: Moeda ta Deos minerien o babos'ani pesasa? Ta Deos minerien o babosa pana choa isas, pan'isas o Deos, michoṣar a pattite, o auchos maabisse-bissé tsjes.
standard: Moeda ta Deos minerien o babos'ani pesasa? Ta Deos minerien o babosa pana choa isas, pan'isas o Deos, michoṣar a pattite, o auchos maabissebissé tsjes.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_13
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Well, then, are all men righteous? By no means; they have all transgressed, and been conceived in iniquity and corruption.
form: Oedan, ja mabisse tsjes tapos o babosa? Paḡaḡa chaddai: kinummossi ja patapos ṣo-o ausjimen inni arapies.
standard: Oedan, ja mabisse tsjes tapos o babosa? Paḡaḡa chaddai: kinummossi ja patapos ṣoo ausjimen inni arapies.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_14
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what does the iniquity of the human heart consist? In rebellion against God, and transgressing against His commandments.
form: Numm'ija arapies o tsjes inni babosa? Kummossi i ta Deos, ṣo-o chumpir o choa atilló.
standard: Numm'ija arapies o tsjes inni babosa? Kummossi i ta Deos, ṣoo chumpir o choa atilló.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_15
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Whence does this iniquity of the heart in man arise? It originates in the transgression of our first forefathers, Adam and Eve in paradise.
form: Innainumma tummoach o arapies o tsjes o mini inni babosa? Innai kakossi o ta Adam a Eva torroa boeboeno pesasa lallum paradiso.
standard: Innainumma tummoach o arapies o tsjes o mini inni babosa? Innai kakossi o ta Adam a Eva torroa boeboeno pesasa lallum paradiso.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_16
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what does the punishment of iniquity and transgression consist? In all kinds of sicknesses, terror, fear, and affliction of the mind; with death, and, after death, hell-fire.
form: Numm'ija chachalt o arapies a kakossi? Mauromaroman a dig, aurtsi, ikkil, a zichil o tsjes, machá, ṣo-o a-i-jor a machá chau o Gehenna.
standard: Numm'ija chachalt o arapies a kakossi? Mauromaroman a dig, aurtsi, ikkil, a zichil o tsjes, machá, ṣoo aijor a machá chau o Gehenna.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_17
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Is there no redemption for these transgressions, so that men may escape them? Yes.
form: Ja alli paga lalaslas o kakossi, ino barrasan o babos'o chachalt o mini? Paga.
standard: Ja alli paga lalaslas o kakossi, ino barrasan o babos'o chachalt o mini? Paga.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_18
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Who has paid the penalty for the transgressions of man? Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who is verily God and man in one person.
form: Tommada cho linummaslas o kakossi o babosa? Ta Jesus Christus sjiem o Deos, o ai paga Deos o gagil ṣo-o gagil o babos'inni nattada boa.
standard: Tommada cho linummaslas o kakossi o babosa? Ta Jesus Christus sjiem o Deos, o ai paga Deos o gagil ṣoo gagil o babos'inni nattada boa.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_19
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: In what way did Christ pay the penalty for the transgressions of man? He suffered for us; He shed His blood, and died on account of our transgressions.
form: Moeda ta Christus linummaslas o kakossi o baboṣa? Minachoté, sinummaod o taḡḡa, ṣo-o minachadau i torro, inau torroa kakossi.
standard: Moeda ta Christus linummaslas o kakossi o baboṣa? Minachoté, sinummaod o taḡḡa, ṣoo minachadau i torro, inau torroa kakossi.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_20
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has Christ reconciled, by His sufferings, God to man? Yes; He is the Mediator between God and man.
form: Ja ta Christus o choa machoté pinaborr'i ta Deos o babosa? Hena: icho paga ma-áborra tuppach o Deos a babosa.
standard: Ja ta Christus o choa machoté pinaborr'i ta Deos o babosa? Hena: icho paga maáborra tuppach o Deos a babosa.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_21
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Will God be merciful to man for the sake of the atonement of His Son? Yes; Christ by His atonement intercedes, so that man obtains the forgiveness of sin.
form: Ja ta Deos merab o mabono babosa, inau lalaslas o choa sjiem? Hena: ta Christus pazinadóno choa lalaslas, alla babosa marach o ábono kakossi.
standard: Ja ta Deos merab o mabono babosa, inau lalaslas o choa sjiem? Hena: ta Christus pazinadóno choa lalaslas, alla babosa marach o ábono kakossi.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_22
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do all men receive the forgiveness of sin? By no means; only they who repent of their sins, and follow after His commandments.
form: Ja tapos o babosa marach o ábono kakossi? Maini-éna; ma-akammichi o ai machi'o kakossi poetautat inni ta Deos, ṣo-o ummior o choa atillo.
standard: Ja tapos o babosa marach o ábono kakossi? Mainiéna; maakammichi o ai machi'o kakossi poetautat inni ta Deos, ṣoo ummior o choa atillo.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_23
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Are the disobedient and the unbelieving not delivered from the punishment of sin? No; the wrath of God abides on them.
form: Ja alli barrasan o chachalt o kakossi chono ma-achachuppir, ṣo-o marotul o autat inni ta Deos? Maini: rais o ta Deos machon i babósar o decho.
standard: Ja alli barrasan o chachalt o kakossi chono maachachuppir, ṣoo marotul o autat inni ta Deos? Maini: rais o ta Deos machon i babósar o decho.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_24
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What must man believe? All that is written in the Word of God, the short heads of which are found in the Christian Belief.
form: Maspot a poetautat onumm'ija babosa? Tapos o ai kabinidoan inni ranied o Deos, innainumma paga ma-apapp'a tuppo inni autat o Christan.
standard: Maspot a poetautat onumm'ija babosa? Tapos o ai kabinidoan inni ranied o Deos, innainumma paga maapapp'a tuppo inni autat o Christan.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_25
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you know the Articles of Faith? Yes: I believe in God, the Father, etc.
form: Ja mab'ijonoë o tuppono autat o Christan? Hena: ka-na-a poetautat inni Deos o tamau, etc.
standard: Ja mab'ijonoë o tuppono autat o Christan? Hena: ka naa poetautat inni Deos o tamau, etc.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_26
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Has God declared in His Word that He will forgive sin? Yes; and He shows us in Christian Baptism and in the Lord's Supper what the forgiveness of sin is.
form: Ja ta Deos inni choa ranied pinab'o pape'o abono kakossi? Hena: ṣo-o patorrod o ábona kakossi inni Christan a sasikir i to, ṣo-o man o marpes'o ta Christus.
standard: Ja ta Deos inni choa ranied pinab'o pape'o abono kakossi? Hena: ṣoo patorrod o ábona kakossi inni Christan a sasikir i to, ṣoo man o marpes'o ta Christus.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_27
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How by the Christian ceremony of baptism? When He commands to baptize the people, so that their sins may be forgiven.
form: Moedaṣar inni Christan a dog o sasikir i to? Ṣabanno pattillo sumkir i tono cho, ino aboan choa kakossi.
standard: Moedaṣar inni Christan a dog o sasikir i to? Ṣabanno pattillo sumkir i tono cho, ino aboan choa kakossi.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_28
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: How by the Lord's Supper? When Christ says of the cup: That is My blood, shed for the remission of sin.
form: Masanno ini dog o man o marpesa? Ṣabanno maunis-o-ala ta Christus innai ai-chám-an o, micho ja na-a taḡḡ'o ai, ṣa-odden ino aboan kakossi.
standard: Masanno ini dog o man o marpesa? Ṣabanno maunis o ala ta Christus innai aicháman o, micho ja naa taḡḡ'o ai, ṣaodden ino aboan kakossi.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_29
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does the water at the ceremony of baptism signify? The water which is sprinkled signifies the blood of Christ, and the sprinkling of the water the sprinkling of His blood.
form: Pait'onumm'ija to inni dog o sasikir i to? To, o ai ipábichi, pait'o taḡḡ'o ta Christus, ṣo-o abichi o to pait'o abichi o choa taḡḡa.
standard: Pait'onumm'ija to inni dog o sasikir i to? To, o ai ipábichi, pait'o taḡḡ'o ta Christus, ṣoo abichi o to pait'o abichi o choa taḡḡa.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_30
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Explain the signification of this ceremony. Even as the body is washed with water, in the same way the soul and body are washed with the blood of Christ from iniquity and sin.
form: Illáḡḡana o lido o dog o mini. Maibas orichen o to a bog, masini orichen o bog a tsjes o taḡḡ'o ta Christus innai arapies a kakossi.
standard: Illáḡḡana o lido o dog o mini. Maibas orichen o to a bog, masini orichen o bog a tsjes o taḡḡ'o ta Christus innai arapies a kakossi.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_31
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Where are we taught to pray for the remission of sin? In the prayer of our Lord Jesus Christ.
form: Dem'ija atillan ja namo meach'o ábono kakossi? Inni ai-ach'o ma-achachimit ja torro ta Jesus Christus.
standard: Dem'ija atillan ja namo meach'o ábono kakossi? Inni aiach'o maachachimit ja torro ta Jesus Christus.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_32
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you know the words of this prayer? Yes, I do: Our Father which art in heaven, etc.
form: Ja mab'ijonoë o atite o ai-ach'o mini? Hena: namoa tamau tamasea paga de boesum, etc.
standard: Ja mab'ijonoë o atite o aiach'o mini? Hena: namoa tamau tamasea paga de boesum, etc.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_33
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Does not the doctrine of the forgiveness of sin encourage man to sin? No; it rather incites man to struggle against sin, and to strive after good works.
form: Ja atil o ábono kakossi alli pákossi o babosa? Maini: kamaso pizich o mapiech o kakossi, ṣo-o ummior o mario a tataap, ino adassen ta Deos, ṣo-o choa bó.
standard: Ja atil o ábono kakossi alli pákossi o babosa? Maini: kamaso pizich o mapiech o kakossi, ṣoo ummior o mario a tataap, ino adassen ta Deos, ṣoo choa bó.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_34
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What do you call good works? All the works of righteousness and holiness commanded by God in His ten commandments.
form: Pattonan onúmm'ijonoë o mario a tataap? Tapos o tataap o babissé achimit, o ai pattillo ta Deos inni tschiet o átillo.
standard: Pattonan onúmm'ijonoë o mario a tataap? Tapos o tataap o babissé achimit, o ai pattillo ta Deos inni tschiet o átillo.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_35
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: What does God command in His ten commandments? Two things: to love God and to love our neighbour.
form: Numm'ija pattillo ta Deos inni tschiet o átillo? Narroa-da tuppo: aukat o Deos, ṣo-o aukat o ma-achaddik o cho.
standard: Numm'ija pattillo ta Deos inni tschiet o átillo? Narroada tuppo: aukat o Deos, ṣoo aukat o maachaddik o cho.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_36
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Do you know the ten commandments? Yes; God spake, I am the Lord thy God, etc.
form: Ja mab'o tschiet o atillo ijonoë? Hena: ta Deos machó: kaina paga ta Jehova oa Deos-oë, etc.
standard: Ja mab'o tschiet o atillo ijonoë? Hena: ta Deos machó: kaina paga ta Jehova oa Deosoë, etc.

section_title: A Short Catechism Before Receiving Christian Baptism
label: item_37
notes: Printed numbered item aligned to the corresponding English item; boundary number omitted
translation: Is God praised when His children follow His commandments? Yes; when the strangers see the righteous works of God's children, they admire them, and praise the Lord and His statutes.
form: Ja adassen ta Deos, ṣabanno choa sisjiem ummior o choa atillo? Hena: ṣabanno azjies miall'o tataap o babissé o sisjiem o Deos, makakki ja choa tsjes, ṣo-o ṣummoal i ta Deos a choa bisse-bissé.
